Similarly, medieval scholastic theologians spent decades categorizing the moral virtues of monastic ascetics.
Consequently, educational institutions began mandating logic examinations for all incoming undergraduate students.

q:
Read the academic passage where a crucial sentence has been omitted at [X]:

"For centuries, philosophical consensus maintained that knowledge could be comprehensively defined as justified true belief. Under this classical Tripartite account, an agent knows a proposition if they believe it, it is objectively true, and they possess adequate epistemic justification for holding it. [X] In his seminal 1963 paper, Edmund Gettier demonstrated through counterexamples that an agent can possess justified true belief based on sheer epistemic serendipity, thereby proving the classical conditions insufficient for genuine knowledge."

Which sentence, if inserted into [X], most effectively maintains the logical coherence and argumentative progression of the passage?
explanation:
Tahlil: Matn klassik bilish nazariyasidagi 'asoslangan haqiqiy e'tiqod' (justified true belief - JTB) ta'rifidan 1963-yilda Edmund Gettier tomonidan ilgari surilgan kontr-misollarga o'tadi. [X] nuqtasi asrlar davomida hukmron bo'lgan ortodoksal qarashning inqirozga yuz tutganini bildiruvchi qarshilantiruvchi ('However') va nazariy burilish yasovchi jumlani talab qiladi.

q:
Read the following testimonial written by an economics professor for an applicant seeking a tenure-track university post:

*"To the Search Committee: Dr. Arisov was invariably punctual to staff meetings, and his office was always impeccably tidy. Sincerely, Prof. Vance."*

In Gricean pragmatic theory, what conversational implicature is generated by this letter, and through which communicative mechanism?
opts: The writer flouts the Maxim of Quantity by withholding relevant information regarding scholarship and teaching, thereby implicating that the candidate is academically mediocre.
The writer violates the Maxim of Quality by deliberately forging false factual claims regarding the applicant’s punctuality.
The writer flouts the Maxim of Manner by drafting an excessively ambiguous and verbose document.
The writer opts out of the Cooperative Principle by refusing to participate in the employment process.
explanation: By providing conspicuously scant, superficial details (punctuality and tidy office) when extensive scholarly evaluation is required, the writer flouts the Maxim of Quantity, deliberately generating the implicature that the candidate lacks genuine academic distinction.
mnemonic: Flouting Quantity: Withholding expected substantive data generates a damming implicature.

q:
Read the pharmaceutical report statement:

*"In the initial Phase II clinical trials, some of the oncology patients exhibited severe nausea."*

What scalar implicature is pragmatic listeners warranted in drawing from this utterance under the Maxim of Quantity?
opts: Every single oncology patient without exception exhibited nausea.
Not all of the oncology patients exhibited severe nausea.
The oncology trial was an unmitigated clinical catastrophe.
The pharmaceutical compound is proven to be completely non-toxic.
explanation: On the quantitative scale <all, most, many, some>, asserting the weaker scalar value 'some' implicates that the speaker was not in an epistemic position to assert the stronger value 'all', generating the scalar implicature: 'some, but not all'.
mnemonic: Scalar Implicature: Choosing 'some' implicates 'not all' under Quantity.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"The deployment of deep neural networks in diagnostic medicine has sparked intense debate concerning the 'black box' problem. While convolutional architectures can classify radiographic anomalies with accuracy surpassing seasoned radiologists, their decision-making pathways remain mathematically opaque. Unlike traditional rule-based expert systems where inference steps can be audited linearly, deep models synthesize millions of non-linear weight adjustments across hidden layers. When an algorithm flags an incipient malignant nodule, clinicians cannot readily identify which pixel constellations drove the classification. Consequently, medical ethicists argue that without explainable AI (XAI) frameworks capable of generating human-interpretable rationales, algorithmic recommendations cannot satisfy the legal standard of informed clinical consent."

Which of the following best encapsulates the primary dilemma articulated by the author?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"The deployment of deep neural networks in diagnostic medicine has sparked intense debate concerning the 'black box' problem. When an algorithm flags an incipient malignant nodule, clinicians cannot readily identify which pixel constellations drove the classification. Consequently, medical ethicists argue that without explainable AI (XAI) frameworks capable of generating human-interpretable rationales, algorithmic recommendations cannot satisfy the legal standard of informed clinical consent."

Which of the following best encapsulates the primary dilemma articulated by the author?
opts: The tension between exceptional diagnostic performance and the absence of epistemological transparency in deep learning systems.
The prohibitive financial investment required to replace seasoned radiologists with automated computational diagnostic tools.
The absolute refusal of modern clinicians to acknowledge radiographic anomalies identified by rule-based algorithmic models.
The computational impossibility of calculating non-linear weight adjustments within multi-layered neural networks.
options: The tension between exceptional diagnostic performance and the absence of epistemological transparency in deep learning systems.
The prohibitive financial investment required to replace seasoned radiologists with automated computational diagnostic tools.
The absolute refusal of modern clinicians to acknowledge radiographic anomalies identified by rule-based algorithmic models.
The computational impossibility of calculating non-linear weight adjustments within multi-layered neural networks.
explanation:
Tahlil: Matn chuqur neyron tarmoqlarining yuqori diagnostik aniqligi hamda ularning qaror qabul qilish jarayonining shaffof emasligi ('black box' problem, epistemologik shaffoflik yo'qligi) o'rtasidagi ziddiyatni asosiy muammo sifatida ko'rsatadi.
To'g'ri javob: Yuksak diagnostik samaradorlik va tushuntirib bera olmaslik o'rtasidagi ziddiyat.
Chalg'ituvchilar: moliyaviy xarajatlar matnda yo'q; shifokorlarning inkor qilishi aytilmagan; og'irliklarni hisoblab bo'lmasligi noto'g'ri.
Eslatma: Asosiy g'oyani aniqlashda matn boshidagi muammo qo'yilishi va yakuniy xulosaga tayaniladi.
mnemonic: Black box dilemma = High accuracy vs Low explainability.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarga "Shahrimizga kelgan xorijiy sayyohlar uchun bir kunlik eng qulay marshrutni rejalashtirish" mavzusida TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) darsini o'tmoqda. J. Willis modeli bo'yicha u 'Pre-task' (Topshiriqdan oldingi) bosqichida qaysi pedagogik harakatni amalga oshirishi metodik jihatdan eng to'g'ri sanaladi?
opts: Mavzuni kiritish, o'quvchilarda mavzuga oid bilimlarni faollashtirish va vazifa talablarini tushuntirish, zarur hollarda o'xshash topshiriqning namunaviy audio/video yozuvini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarga kerak bo'ladigan barcha yangi grammatik qoidalar va so'zlarni oldindan doskaga yozib, ularni mexanik mashqlar orqali yodlatish
O'quvchilarni darhol guruhlarga bo'lib, ulardan hech qanday ko'rsatmasiz mustaqil ravishda yakuniy hisobotni yozishni talab qilish
Topshiriq bajarib bo'linganidan so'ng o'quvchilar yo'l qo'ygan barcha nutqiy xatolarni doskada tahlil qilib berish
explanation: Jane Willis TBLT modelida Pre-task bosqichining asosiy maqsadi — o'quvchilarni vazifaga tayyorlash, mavzuga oid konseptual va lug'aviy bilimlarni (schemata) faollashtirish hamda topshiriq maqsadini aniq tushuntirishdir. Bu bosqichda grammatikani mexanik o'rgatish TBLT tamoyillariga zid.
mnemonic: Pre-task = Schemata faollashtirish + Maqsad va namunani ko'rsatish.

q: Jamshid o'z darsida TBLT Task Cycle (Topshiriq sikli) bosqichini tashkil etmoqda. O'quvchilar guruhda muammoni hal qilishdi va endi o'z natijalarini butun sinfga og'zaki taqdimot qilishlari kerak. Taqdimotdan oldingi 'Planning' (Rejalashtirish) bosqichida o'qituvchining asosiy roli nimadan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Sinfdagi barcha o'quvchilarni to'xtatib, frontal usulda taqdimot uchun yagona majburiy matn shablonini diktovka qilish
O'quvchilarga hisobot matnini tuzish va nutqni sayqallashda maslahatchi (language advisor) sifatida yordam berish hamda aniqlik (accuracy) ustida ishlashlariga ko'maklashish
O'quvchilarning har bir grammatik xatosini darhol to'xtatib tuzatish va baho qo'yish
Jarayonga umuman aralashmasdan, keyingi dars materiallarini tayyorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lish
explanation: Task Cycle ichidagi Planning bosqichida o'quvchilar erkin muloqotdan (fluency) o'z nutqini rasmiy taqdimotga moslashtirish (accuracy) tomon harakat qiladilar. O'qituvchi bu paytda maslahatchi bo'lib, til birliklarini to'g'ri tanlashga ko'maklashadi.
mnemonic: Planning bosqichi = Maslahatchi o'qituvchi + Aniqlik (accuracy) va tuzilishga tayyorgarlik.

q:
Mrs. Dalloway paused beside the open French windows, looking down at the sunlit terrace where the morning light splintered upon the gravel like shattered glass. What a plunge! Did it matter that in an hour the florist would arrive, that Richard was lunching with Lady Bruton, that Clarissa herself was growing old? A sudden puff of wind brought the distant tolling of Big Ben—first the warning, musical; then the hour, irrevocable. The leaden circles dissolved in the air. For an instant, she felt the terrifying fragility of living, how trivial party arrangements were merely paper barriers erected against the monstrous tide of oblivion.

What psychological tension dominates Clarissa's interior monologue in the passage?
question:
Mrs. Dalloway paused beside the open French windows, looking down at the sunlit terrace where the morning light splintered upon the gravel like shattered glass. What a plunge! Did it matter that in an hour the florist would arrive, that Richard was lunching with Lady Bruton, that Clarissa herself was growing old? A sudden puff of wind brought the distant tolling of Big Ben—first the warning, musical; then the hour, irrevocable. The leaden circles dissolved in the air. For an instant, she felt the terrifying fragility of living, how trivial party arrangements were merely paper barriers erected against the monstrous tide of oblivion.

What psychological tension dominates Clarissa's interior monologue in the passage?
options: The jarring contrast between superficial social domesticities and an existential dread of mortality.
Intense jealousy regarding her husband's private professional engagements with aristocracy.
Anxious panic that her caterers will fail to deliver the requested flowers before the guests arrive.
Resentment toward the urban noise of London disrupting her desired country retirement.
opts: The jarring contrast between superficial social domesticities and an existential dread of mortality.
Intense jealousy regarding her husband's private professional engagements with aristocracy.
Anxious panic that her caterers will fail to deliver the requested flowers before the guests arrive.
Resentment toward the urban noise of London disrupting her desired country retirement.
explanation:
Tahlil: Klerissa Delloueyning ichki monologida oddiy kundalik tashvishlar (gullar keltirilishi, erining tushligi) bilan inson umrining o'tkinchiligi, qarish va o'lim ('monstrous tide of oblivion') o'rtasidagi keskin ziddiyat (existential dread) bosh mavzu qilib olingan. Big Ben soatining jaranglashi bu muqarrar vaqt oqimini eslatadi.
To'g'ri javob: Yuzaki ijtimoiy-maishiy tashvishlar bilan o'lim va foniylikdan qo'rqish o'rtasidagi keskin ziddiyat.
Chalg'ituvchilar: erining xiyonatidan rashk qilish emas; gullar kechikishi haqidagi vahima asosiy emas; London shovqinidan g'azablanish emas.
Eslatma: Woolfian interior monologue = Juxtaposition of mundane domesticity against existential mortality.
mnemonic: Mrs Dalloway = Mundane party trivia stands fragile against the leaden tide of mortality.

q: Metodbirlashma yig'ilishida Nilufar an'anaviy PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production) modeli bilan TBLT o'rtasidagi farqni tushuntirib bermoqchi. Quyidagi tahlillardan qaysi biri TBLT ning mohiyatini eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ifodalaydi?
opts: TBLT modelida o'quvchilar hech qachon guruhda ishlamaydi, PPPda esa doimo juftlikda ishlanadi
PPP faqat muloqotga qaratilgan, TBLT esa faqat qat'iy grammatik qoidalarni yodlatishga xizmat qiladi
PPP til shaklini oldindan belgilab, uni mashq qildirsa, TBLTda muloqot birlamchi bo'lib, til vositalari (language focus) topshiriq ehtiyojidan kelib chiqqan holda dars oxirida tahlil qilinadi
PPPda xatolar tuzatilmaydi, TBLTda esa o'qituvchi har bir noto'g'ri aytilgan so'z uchun darhol jarima qo'llaydi
explanation: PPP sintetik model bo'lib, til birliklari bo'laklarga ajratilib o'rgatiladi (Form -> Meaning -> Use). TBLT esa analitik yondashuv bo'lib, muloqot jarayonida yuzaga chiqqan til bo'shliqlari 'Language Focus' bosqichida tahlil qilinadi.
mnemonic: PPP = Avval qoida, keyin muloqot; TBLT = Avval muloqot va vazifa, keyin til tahlili.

q: Farhod o'quv dasturiga TBLT topshiriqlarini kiritishda Nunan tasnifiga ko'ra 'Real-world (target) task' va 'Pedagogical task' farqini tahlil qilmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 'Pedagogical task' (pedagogik topshiriq) hisoblanadi?
opts: Xorijiy mehmonxona resepsheniga qo'ng'iroq qilib, xona bron qilish bo'yicha real suhbat qurish
O'quvchining internet orqali real aviakompaniya saytidan Toshkent-London reysiga chipta band qilishi
O'quvchining haqiqiy xalqaro do'konga buyurtma berish uchun rasmiy elektron xat jo'natishi
O'quvchilarning ikkita bir-biridan farqli rasmlar orasidagi 7 ta farqni bir-biriga ko'rsatmasdan, faqat savol-javob orqali topishi (Spot the differences)
explanation: Pedagogik topshiriq (Pedagogical task) real hayotda aynan uchramasa-da, real muloqot ko'nikmalarini (savol berish, taqqoslash, tushuntirish) sinf xonasida shakllantirish uchun maxsus loyihalashtirilgan sun'iy o'quv vazifasidir.
mnemonic: Pedagogical task = Sinf ichidagi maxsus muloqot mashqi; Target task = Real hayotiy amaliyot.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Quantum computational supremacy hinges upon quantum superposition and entanglement, enabling qubits to explore exponential state spaces simultaneously. However, decoherence—induced by thermal fluctuations, stray electromagnetic fields, and material impurities—presents an existential obstacle to fault-tolerant quantum computation. When physical qubits interact with ambient environmental noise, their delicate phase relationships collapse, transforming coherent quantum superpositions into classical statistical mixtures. Current Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices rely on topological shielding and surface codes for error correction, yet the physical-to-logical qubit overhead remains astronomical: thousands of physical qubits are often required to synthesize a single fault-tolerant logical qubit."

Based on the text, what can be logically inferred regarding the transition from NISQ systems to truly fault-tolerant quantum computers?
question:

"Quantum computational supremacy hinges upon quantum superposition and entanglement, enabling qubits to explore exponential state spaces simultaneously. Current Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices rely on topological shielding and surface codes for error correction, yet the physical-to-logical qubit overhead remains astronomical: thousands of physical qubits are often required to synthesize a single fault-tolerant logical qubit."

Based on the text, what can be logically inferred regarding the transition from NISQ systems to truly fault-tolerant quantum computers?
opts: Thermal shielding alone will immediately obviate the necessity for quantum error-correcting codes in commercial hardware.
Massive hardware scaling is required to mitigate error rates because individual logical qubits demand vast physical qubit redundancy.
Quantum supremacy will soon be abandoned in favor of classical supercomputers due to insurmountable material impurities.
Superposition will be replaced by classical binary states to permanently circumvent ambient environmental decoherence.
options: Thermal shielding alone will immediately obviate the necessity for quantum error-correcting codes in commercial hardware.
Massive hardware scaling is required to mitigate error rates because individual logical qubits demand vast physical qubit redundancy.
Quantum supremacy will soon be abandoned in favor of classical supercomputers due to insurmountable material impurities.
Superposition will be replaced by classical binary states to permanently circumvent ambient environmental decoherence.
explanation:
Tahlil: Matnda bitta mantiqiy qubit uchun minglab fizik qubitlar talab qilinishi ('thousands of physical qubits are often required to synthesize a single fault-tolerant logical qubit') aytilgan. Bu tizimni kengaytirish va xatolarni kamaytirish uchun ulkan fizik ortiqchalik (redundancy) zarurligini bildiradi.
To'g'ri javob: Mantiqiy qubitlar katta miqdordagi fizik qubitlar ortiqchaligini talab qilishi tufayli apparat miqyosini kengaytirish zarurati.
Chalg'ituvchilar: faqat termal himoya xatolik kodlarini yo'qotmaydi; kvantdan voz kechish aytilmagan; superpozitsiyadan voz kechish kvant hisoblashni yo'qqa chiqaradi.
Eslatma: Xulosa chiqarishda 'qubit overhead' tushunchasiga tayaniladi.
mnemonic: Qubit overhead = Thousands of physical qubits needed per single logical qubit.

q: Malika TBLT darsida 'Language Focus' (Tahlil va amaliyot) bosqichini o'tkazmoqda. O'quvchilar topshiriqni bajarib, hisobot berib bo'lishdi. Bu bosqichda o'qituvchining eng maqbul vazifasi nima?
opts: Topshiriq jarayonida o'quvchilar ishlatgan yoki qiynalgan aniq til tuzilmalari, ifodalar va xatoliklarni matn va audio kontekstida tahlil qilish hamda amaliyotda mustahkamlash
Yangi boshqa bir grammatik mavzuni noldan tushuntirib, uyga 50 ta mashq berish
O'quvchilarga hech narsa tushuntirmasdan darsni yakunlash
O'quvchilarning shaxsiyatiga tegadigan qattiq tanqidiy mulohazalar bildirish
explanation: Willis modeli bo'yicha 'Language Focus' bosqichi o'quvchilar topshiriq davomida duch kelgan real leksik-grammatik tuzilmalarni ongli tahlil qilish (analysis) va mustahkamlash (practice) uchun ajratiladi.
mnemonic: Language Focus = Topshiriqdan kelib chiqqan til vositalarini ongli tahlil qilish.

q: Jasur sinfda TBLT ning 'Jigsaw' (mozaika) turidagi topshirig'ini qo'lladi. Har bir guruh a'zosiga umumiy hikoyaning faqat bittadan parchasi berildi. Ular bir-birlarining qog'oziga qaramasdan butun voqeani tiklashlari kerak. Ushbu topshiriqning kommunikativ qiymati nimada?
opts: O'quvchilarga matnni mustaqil tarjima qilish qulay bo'ladi
Haqiqiy axborot almashinuvi (Information gap) va o'zaro ikki tomonlama bog'liqlikni (Two-way task) vujudga keltiradi
O'qituvchiga darsda dam olish imkoniyatini yaratadi
O'quvchilar orasida raqobatni kuchaytirib, ularni bir-biri bilan gaplashmaslikka undaydi
explanation: Jigsaw topshiriqlari 'two-way information gap' yaratadi: hech bir o'quvchi to'liq ma'lumotga ega emas, yakuniy natijaga faqat faol muloqot va barcha a'zolar o'z qismini og'zaki yetkazishi orqaligina erishiladi.
mnemonic: Jigsaw Task = 2 tomonlama axborot bo'shlig'i (Two-way info gap) va muqarrar hamkorlik.

q: O'qituvchi yangi o'quv choragi uchun mavzular rejasini tuzishda Grant Wiggins va Jay McTighe tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan "Teskari dizayn" (Backward Design) modelini qo'llamoqchi. Ushbu metodologiyaga muvofiq, rejalashtirish bosqichlarining eng to'g'ri ketma-ketligi qaysi javobda keltirilgan?
opts: 1) Kutilayotgan o'rganish natijalarini aniqlash; 2) Natijaga erishilganini tasdiqlovchi baholash dalillarini belgilash; 3) O'quv tajribalari va dars mashg'ulotlarini rejalashtirish.
1) Darslikdagi matn va mashqlarni tanlash; 2) Dars rejasi va taqdimot tayyorlash; 3) Chorak oxirida summativ nazorat testini tuzish.
1) Baholash mezonlarini ishlab chiqish; 2) Mashg'ulot metodlarini tanlash; 3) Dars oxirida kutilayotgan natijani shakllantirish.
1) O'quvchilarning qiziqishlarini so'rovnoma orqali o'rganish; 2) Dars jadvalini moslashtirish; 3) Mavzular ketma-ketligini belgilash.
explanation: Backward Design (Teskari dizayn) uchta qat'iy bosqichdan iborat: 1-bosqich: Ko'zlangan yakuniy natijani belgilash (Identify desired results); 2-bosqich: Natijani baholash dalillarini aniqlash (Determine acceptable evidence); 3-bosqich: O'qitish va o'rganish faoliyatlarini loyihalash (Plan learning experiences and instruction).
mnemonic: Teskari dizayn qoidasi: Natija -> Baholash dalili -> Dars faoliyati.
Advantage to Bottleneck = Concessive contrast ('Nevertheless').

q:
Mrs. Dalloway paused beside the open French windows, looking down at the sunlit terrace where the morning light splintered upon the gravel like shattered glass. What a plunge! Did it matter that in an hour the florist would arrive, that Richard was lunching with Lady Bruton, that Clarissa herself was growing old? A sudden puff of wind brought the distant tolling of Big Ben—first the warning, musical; then the hour, irrevocable. The leaden circles dissolved in the air. For an instant, she felt the terrifying fragility of living, how trivial party arrangements were merely paper barriers erected against the monstrous tide of oblivion.

How does the author utilize the sensory imagery of Big Ben to structure the narrative rhythm?

q:

q:
Read the academic passage:
"For decades, neurobiological dogma held that neurogenesis in the adult mammalian neocortex was non-existent, asserting that neuronal architecture solidified irrevocably after critical developmental windows. However, contemporary dendritic spine imaging and immunohistochemical assays tracking bromodeoxyuridine (BrdU) incorporation have dismantled this static paradigm. While massive structural neurogenesis remains restricted primarily to the subgranular zone of the dentate gyrus and the subventricular zone, functional synaptic plasticity—characterized by long-term potentiation (LTP) and activity-dependent dendritic remodeling—persists throughout senescence. Experience-dependent epigenetic modifications continually calibrate synaptic strength, demonstrating that cognitive architecture retains dynamic adaptive capacity across the lifespan."

What underlying assumption regarding the mammalian brain was overturned by modern immunohistochemical findings?

Did it matter that in an hour the florist would arrive, that Richard was lunching with Lady Bruton, that Clarissa herself was growing old? A sudden puff of wind brought the distant tolling of Big Ben—first the warning, musical; then the hour, irrevocable. The leaden circles dissolved in the air. For an instant, she felt the terrifying fragility of living, how trivial party arrangements were merely paper barriers erected against the monstrous tide of oblivion.

In the context of the excerpt, the word 'irrevocable' emphasizes that the passing hour is:

Decoders tapping into PPC require substantially fewer training epochs and exhibit greater resilience to neuronal drift, because the abstract motor goal remains invariant even when peripheral muscle activation strategies fluctuate."

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Large language models (LLMs) trained on billions of linguistic tokens exhibit astonishing syntactic fluency, prompting claims of emergent synthetic reasoning. Cognitive philosophers, however, invoke the 'symbol grounding problem' to refute the assertion that these systems possess genuine semantic comprehension. An LLM calculates conditional probability distributions over text sequences, mapping statistical co-occurrences of tokens within high-dimensional vector spaces. Crucially, the model's internal representations are completely decoupled from perceptual sensorimotor experience with the physical referents of those symbols. An algorithm may compose an evocative sonnet describing a sunset without possessing any optical, thermal, or phenomenological grounding of what a sunset entails."

What is the central philosophical counter-argument presented by the author against the claim that LLMs possess true comprehension?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Direct detection of weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs)—the foremost candidate for dark matter—relies on ultra-sensitive dual-phase liquid xenon time projection chambers. Operating deep underground to shield against cosmic muon cascades, these detectors observe rare nuclear recoils. When a WIMP scatters off a xenon nucleus, it produces both scintillation light (S1) and ionization electrons, which drift upward in an electric field to generate electroluminescence (S2). The ratio of S2 to S1 serves as a diagnostic metric to discriminate between signal nuclear recoils and background electron recoils. Despite detector targets expanding to multi-tonne scales, definitive WIMP signatures remain unobserved, pushing constraints perilously close to the 'neutrino fog'—the irreducible background where coherent neutrino-nucleus scattering mimics dark matter signals."

What critical dilemma does the 'neutrino fog' introduce into the experimental search for WIMPs?

q:
Winston kept his back turned toward the telescreen; though as he well knew, even a back can be revealing. He took a twenty-four-hour diary from the drawer—a peculiarly beautiful book with smooth, creamy paper, a little yellowed by age. The thing that he was about to do was to open a diary. This was not illegal (nothing was illegal, since there were no longer any laws), but if detected it was reasonably certain that it would be punished by death, or at least by twenty-five years in a forced-labor camp. He dipped his penholder into the ink and then hesitated for just a second. A tremor had gone through his bowels. To mark the paper was the decisive act. In small clumsy letters he wrote: April 4th, 1984.

What paradox regarding totalitarian law is articulated in the excerpt?

Bu erkinlik emas, balki qonun ustuvorligining yo'qligi va mutlaq o'zboshimchalik (arbitrary state terror) ekanligini fosh qiladi.
To'g'ri javob: Rasmiy yozilgan qonunlar bo'lmagani uchun hech narsa noqonuniy emas, ammo har qanday erkin harakat o'lim bilan jazolanishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: kundalik tutish majburiy emas (taqiqlangan); qora siyoh taqiqlanmagan; sudlar politsiyani bekor qilmagan.
Eslatma: Totalitarian paradox = Absence of codified law creates absolute arbitrary lethal terror.
mnemonic: Orwellian law paradox = No written laws exist, yet any personal thought invites lethal execution.

q:
Winston kept his back turned toward the telescreen; though as he well knew, even a back can be revealing. He took a twenty-four-hour diary from the drawer—a peculiarly beautiful book with smooth, creamy paper, a little yellowed by age. The thing that he was about to do was to open a diary. This was not illegal (nothing was illegal, since there were no longer any laws), but if detected it was reasonably certain that it would be punished by death, or at least by twenty-five years in a forced-labor camp. He dipped his penholder into the ink and then hesitated for just a second. A tremor had gone through his bowels. To mark the paper was the decisive act. In small clumsy letters he wrote: April 4th, 1984.

What is the primary psychological significance of beginning the diary for Winston?

What is the primary psychological significance of beginning the diary for Winston?
options: It allows him to submit comprehensive monthly financial accounting records to the Ministry of Love.
It constitutes an irreversible declaration of personal intellectual autonomy and rebellion against the state.
It serves as a legal document to sell his private apartment to the Party hierarchy.
It proves that he lacks the basic manual motor skills required to operate printing machinery.
opts: It allows him to submit comprehensive monthly financial accounting records to the Ministry of Love.
It constitutes an irreversible declaration of personal intellectual autonomy and rebellion against the state.
It serves as a legal document to sell his private apartment to the Party hierarchy.
It proves that he lacks the basic manual motor skills required to operate printing machinery.
explanation:
Tahlil: Vinstonning qog'ozga qalam bilan yozishga qaror qilishi ('To mark the paper was the decisive act') — shunchaki esdalik emas, balki o'z shaxsiyati, fikrlash erkinligi va ichki mustaqilligini partiya diktaturasiga qarshi e'lon qilish, ya'ni ruhiy isyonning boshlanishidir.
To'g'ri javob: Shaxsiy intellektual muxtoriyat va davlatga qarshi isyonning orqaga qaytmas deklaratsiyasi bo'lishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: Sevgi vazirligiga moliyaviy hisobot berish emas; uyni sotish shartnomasi emas; bosma mashinani ishlata olmaslik belgisi emas.
Eslatma: Diary as political rebellion = Marking paper establishes private historical consciousness against state erasure.
mnemonic: Orwellian diary = Committing ink to paper constitutes an irrevocable act of existential rebellion.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Nanomedicine has historically championed the Enhanced Permeability and Retention (EPR) effect as the foundational rationale for oncological nanoparticle targeting. The paradigm posited that rapidly vascularized solid tumors display fenestrated endothelium and deficient lymphatic drainage, permitting extravasation and selective accumulation of liposomes. However, contemporary quantitative biodistribution studies reveal that the clinical efficacy of EPR was vastly overstated: less than one percent of administered nanoparticle doses typically penetrate the tumor parenchyma. The dense extracellular collagen matrix, elevated interstitial fluid pressure, and active clearance by hepatic and splenic macrophages form severe physiological barriers, necessitating active transcytosis mechanisms rather than reliance on passive endothelial permeability."

Which of the following best describes the transition in oncological nanomedicine described by the author?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"Nanomedicine has historically championed the Enhanced Permeability and Retention (EPR) effect as the foundational rationale for oncological nanoparticle targeting. The paradigm posited that rapidly vascularized solid tumors display fenestrated endothelium and deficient lymphatic drainage, permitting extravasation and selective accumulation of liposomes. However, contemporary quantitative biodistribution studies reveal that the clinical efficacy of EPR was vastly overstated: less than one percent of administered nanoparticle doses typically penetrate the tumor parenchyma. The dense extracellular collagen matrix, elevated interstitial fluid pressure, and active clearance by hepatic and splenic macrophages form severe physiological barriers, necessitating active transcytosis mechanisms rather than reliance on passive endothelial permeability."

Which of the following best describes the transition in oncological nanomedicine described by the author?
opts: From reliance on passive physiological accumulation to the necessity of active transport mechanisms.
From active molecular transcytosis back to traditional whole-body radiation therapies.
From complete rejection of liposomal delivery to exclusive reliance on passive fenestration.
From targeting malignant tumors to treating non-malignant hepatic and splenic inflammations.
options: From reliance on passive physiological accumulation to the necessity of active transport mechanisms.
From active molecular transcytosis back to traditional whole-body radiation therapies.
From complete rejection of liposomal delivery to exclusive reliance on passive fenestration.
From targeting malignant tumors to treating non-malignant hepatic and splenic inflammations.
explanation:
Tahlil: Matnda dastlab passiv to'planish (EPR) yetarli deb hisoblangani, ammo amalda uning 1% dan kam ekani ma'lum bo'lgach, faol transport (active transcytosis) mexanizmlariga o'tish zarurligi ta'kidlanadi.
To'g'ri javob: Passiv fiziologik to'planishdan faol transport mexanizmlari zaruratiga o'tish.
Chalg'ituvchilar: radiatsiya terapiyasiga qaytish aytilmagan; passiv usulga qaytish teskari; jigar yallig'lanishini davolashga o'tish aytilmagan.
Eslatma: Yo'nalish o'zgarishi: passiv EPR -> faol transsitoz.
mnemonic: Shift from passive EPR to active transcytosis.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Magnetic confinement fusion seeks to replicate stellar nucleosynthesis within terrestrial reactors, primarily through the tokamak geometry. In a tokamak, helical magnetic fields confine a deuterium-tritium plasma heated to hundreds of millions of degrees Kelvin. The fundamental technological bottleneck, however, resides in plasma stability: edge localized modes (ELMs) and turbulence cause rapid heat and particle transport across magnetic flux surfaces, eroding reactor walls and cooling the core below the Lawson ignition criterion. While recent high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets enable stronger toroidal fields within compact architectures, materials capable of withstanding unyielding neutron fluxes without severe embrittlement remain unperfected."

What is the primary factor limiting the immediate commercial deployment of tokamak fusion reactors, according to the passage?

It is sometimes said that a butler of the first rank must inhabit his professional role as a gentleman inhabits his suit: with absolute, seamless naturalness. For my part, I have always believed that 'dignity' has to do crucially with a butler's ability not to abandon the professional being he inhabits. Lesser men will drop their composure at the first hint of strong emotion, or when confronted by personal tragedy. But a truly great butler remains within his role, unshakeable, no matter what events transpire around him. Looking back now upon those decades at Darlington Hall—even when contemplating what transpired during that fateful evening when Miss Kenton wept behind closed doors—I am satisfied that I did not falter. Yet, standing on this pier at Weymouth as the evening lights turn on, an unexpected weight settles upon my chest.

What tragic realization is unveiled beneath Stevens's insistence on professional 'dignity'?

Eslatma: Only After Inversion: Subordinate clause retains normal order; MAIN clause inverts.

It is sometimes said that a butler of the first rank must inhabit his professional role as a gentleman inhabits his suit: with absolute, seamless naturalness. For my part, I have always believed that 'dignity' has to do crucially with a butler's ability not to abandon the professional being he inhabits. Lesser men will drop their composure at the first hint of strong emotion, or when confronted by personal tragedy. But a truly great butler remains within his role, unshakeable, no matter what events transpire around him. Looking back now upon those decades at Darlington Hall—even when contemplating what transpired during that fateful evening when Miss Kenton wept behind closed doors—I am satisfied that I did not falter. Yet, standing on this pier at Weymouth as the evening lights turn on, an unexpected weight settles upon my chest.

How does the narrative perspective function throughout the passage?

Day after day, the sun rose like a drop of molten copper, blazing through a brass sky that pressed down upon the decks like the lid of an oven. Below, the crew lay stricken with fever, their groans filtering through the open skylights. The second mate looked at me with sunken, glassy eyes that had ceased to expect deliverance; in his feverish delirium, he muttered that the old captain's curse had chained us forever to this shadow line between youth and death.

What is the nature of the existential conflict facing the young captain in this narrative?

Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Temporal Negative: 'At no time' + did + Subject + Base Verb.

options: the defendant conceded
did the defendant concede
the defendant was conceding
conceded the defendant

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Solid-state lithium batteries are heralded as the successor to conventional lithium-ion cells, substituting volatile liquid organic electrolytes with solid ceramic or polymer ion conductors. This architecture theoretically permits the utilization of pure lithium metal anodes, vastly increasing energy density while eliminating catastrophic thermal runaway risks. Nonetheless, interfacial degradation remains a formidable challenge: during charge-discharge cycling, non-uniform lithium electrodeposition promotes the propagation of lithium dendrites through ceramic grain boundaries, eventually short-circuiting the cell. Furthermore, the chemo-mechanical expansion and contraction of electrodes induce interfacial void formation, severely degrading ionic conductivity at the solid-solid contact boundary."

What is the primary trade-off described in the adoption of solid-state lithium batteries?

What is the primary trade-off described in the adoption of solid-state lithium batteries?
opts: Drastically reduced manufacturing costs versus lower volumetric energy density compared to liquid cells.
Higher energy density and enhanced thermal safety versus severe solid-solid interfacial degradation and dendrite risks.
Complete elimination of dendrite growth versus dangerous reliance on combustible organic solvents.
Unlimited cycle lifespan versus catastrophic thermal runaway explosions occurring during every charge cycle.
options: Drastically reduced manufacturing costs versus lower volumetric energy density compared to liquid cells.
Higher energy density and enhanced thermal safety versus severe solid-solid interfacial degradation and dendrite risks.

q: O'qituvchi ingliz tilini endigina A2 darajasida o'zlashtirgan 7-sinf o'quvchilari uchun 45 daqiqalik dars maqsadini quyidagicha belgiladi: "Dars davomida o'quvchilar Shekspirning 'Gamlet' tragediyasining original matnini to'liq o'qib, uning falsafiy qatlamlarini C1 darajasida tahlil qiladilar". Ushbu maqsad SMART mezonlarining qaysi tamoyillarini qo'pol ravishda buzadi?
opts: A (Achievable - erishiluvchan) va R (Relevant/Realistic - real haqiqatga moslik) tamoyillarini, chunki vazifa o'quvchilarning yoshi va amaldagi til darajasiga nomutanosib.
Faqat T (Time-bound) tamoyilini, chunki Shekspir asarlari faqat kechki paytlarda o'qilishi tavsiya etiladi.
Faqat S (Specific) tamoyilini, chunki muallifning ismi darslikda bosh harflar bilan yozilishi shart edi.
Hech qanday tamoyil buzilmagan; yuksak talabchanlik har doim eng samarali pedagogik strategiyadir.
explanation: A2 darajasidagi o'quvchiga 45 daqiqada C1 darajasidagi qadimiy Shekspir matnini falsafiy tahlil qilish vazifasini qo'yish uning ZPD (Yaqin rivojlanish hududi) dan ancha yuqori bo'lib, erishib bo'lmaydigan (Unachievable) va noreal (Unrealistic) maqsaddir.
mnemonic: ZPD mutanosibligi: Maqsad o'quvchining amaldagi darajasiga real va erisharli bo'lishi shart.

q: Mohira o'quvchilarga 'maktab hovlisini ko'kalamzorlashtirish loyihasi' bo'yicha TBLT darsini o'tdi. O'quvchilar loyihani yaratishdi, byudjetni hisoblashdi va taqdimot qilishdi. Rod Ellis tasnifiga ko'ra, topshiriqning (task) 'mashq'dan (exercise) asosiy ajralib turuvchi mezoni qaysi?
opts: Topshiriq faqat yozma ravishda bajarilishi
Topshiriqda faqat to'g'ri zamon shakllarini qo'yish talab etilishi
Asosiy e'tibor til shakliga emas, balki pragmatik ma'noga va aniq nom-lingvistik natijaga (non-linguistic outcome) qaratilganligi
Barcha gaplar faqat o'qituvchi tomonidan baholanishi
explanation: Rod Ellis bo'yicha topshiriq (task) mezonlari: 1) Ma'no birlamchi; 2) Axborot bo'shlig'i bor; 3) O'quvchi o'z til resurslariga tayanadi; 4) Aniq nom-lingvistik natija (masalan, loyiha, qaror, reja) mavjud.
mnemonic: Task vs Exercise: Task = Ma'no + O'z resurslari + Aniq hayotiy natija.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"The resolution of the fifty-year-old protein folding problem by deep learning architectures, most prominently AlphaFold, marked a paradigm shift in structural biology. By integrating evolutionary conservation patterns from multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) with geometric deep learning, the model predicts three-dimensional coordinates of polypeptide backbones with atomic accuracy. However, computational biologists caution that predicting a static ground-state structure is distinct from solving protein biophysics. AlphaFold does not model kinetic folding pathways, nor does it capture the conformational ensembles and allosteric transitions essential for enzymatic catalysis. Proteins are dynamic thermodynamic entities, whereas deep learning models primarily generate static crystallographic snapshots."

Which of the following best reflects the limitation of AlphaFold emphasized by the author?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"The resolution of the fifty-year-old protein folding problem by deep learning architectures, most prominently AlphaFold, marked a paradigm shift in structural biology. By integrating evolutionary conservation patterns from multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) with geometric deep learning, the model predicts three-dimensional coordinates of polypeptide backbones with atomic accuracy. However, computational biologists caution that predicting a static ground-state structure is distinct from solving protein biophysics. AlphaFold does not model kinetic folding pathways, nor does it capture the conformational ensembles and allosteric transitions essential for enzymatic catalysis. Proteins are dynamic thermodynamic entities, whereas deep learning models primarily generate static crystallographic snapshots."

Which of the following best reflects the limitation of AlphaFold emphasized by the author?
opts: It fails to process multiple sequence alignments across evolutionary homologs.
It requires physical X-ray crystallographic verification for every amino acid prediction.
It generates static structural predictions rather than dynamic conformational transitions.
It is restricted solely to predicting synthetic polypeptide chains with zero biological relevance.
options: It fails to process multiple sequence alignments across evolutionary homologs.
It requires physical X-ray crystallographic verification for every amino acid prediction.
It generates static structural predictions rather than dynamic conformational transitions.
It is restricted solely to predicting synthetic polypeptide chains with zero biological relevance.
explanation:
Tahlil: AlphaFold statik holatni aniq bashorat qilsa-da, oqsillarning dinamik konformatsion o'zgarishlari va allosterik harakatlarini modellashtira olmaydi. Bu uning asosiy cheklovidir.
To'g'ri javob: Dinamik o'zgarishlar o'rniga faqat statik tuzilma bashoratlarini yaratishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: MSA ni qayta ishlaydi; har bir bashoratni rentgen bilan tekshirish shart emas; sintetik zanjirlarga cheklanmagan.
Eslatma: Cheklov = statik model vs biologik dinamizm.
mnemonic: AlphaFold limitation = Static snapshots != Dynamic biophysical ensembles.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Gravitational wave astronomy, inaugurated by the laser interferometers of LIGO and Virgo, opened an unprecedented observational window into the universe. Unlike photons, which are readily scattered and absorbed by dense interstellar dust clouds, gravitational waves propagate across cosmic spacetime with virtually zero attenuation. The multi-messenger observation of GW170817—a binary neutron star merger detected simultaneously in gravitational waves and across the electromagnetic spectrum (from gamma-ray bursts to optical kilonovae)—confirmed that such cosmic collisions are the primary nucleosynthesis sites for heavy r-process elements like gold and platinum. Thus, gravitational interferometry does not merely observe spacetime ripples; it deciphers the cosmic origin of matter itself."

What unique physical characteristic allows gravitational waves to provide observational insights unavailable to optical astronomy?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have achieved meteoric efficiency gains, leaping from under four percent to over twenty-six percent within a single decade. Their appeal lies in their high absorption coefficient, long carrier diffusion lengths, and low-cost solution processability. However, commercialization is stymied by structural instability. Organic-inorganic lead halide perovskites degrade rapidly under ambient humidity, thermal stress, and continuous ultraviolet illumination. Furthermore, under continuous operational bias, mobile halide ions migrate through the crystal lattice, leading to phase segregation and deep trap-state formation that severely quench photoluminescence and power conversion efficiency."

According to the passage, how does ion migration under operational bias undermine perovskite solar cell performance?

It instantly neutralizes the lead content, rendering the perovskite chemically non-hazardous.

Tahlil: Ishchi kuchlanish ostida ionlarning harakati fazalarning ajralishiga va chuqur tuzoq holatlariga olib keladi, bu esa fotolyuminessensiyani so'ndiradi va quvvatni pasaytiradi.

q: What is the fundamental theoretical distinction between **flouting** a maxim and **violating** a maxim in Gricean pragmatics?
opts: Flouting refers exclusively to grammatical syntax errors, while violating refers to spoken phonology.
Flouting is open and conspicuous, intended to be noticed to generate an implicature, whereas violating is unostentatious and intended to deceive without detection.
Flouting is illegal under criminal law, whereas violating is a minor civil tort.
Flouting occurs only in written literature, while violating occurs only in spontaneous oral dialogue.
explanation: Flouting occurs when a speaker openly, blatantly exploits a maxim so the hearer notices and calculates an implicature. Violating occurs when a speaker quietly breaks a maxim (e.g. lying) to mislead the hearer without being detected.
mnemonic: Flouting vs Violating: Flouting is overt to show meaning; Violating is covert to deceive.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarga "Shahrimizga kelgan xorijiy sayyohlar uchun bir kunlik eng qulay marshrutni rejalashtirish" mavzusida TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) darsini o'tmoqda. J. Willis modeli bo'yicha u 'Pre-task' (Topshiriqdan oldingi) bosqichida qaysi pedagogik harakatni amalga oshirishi metodik jihatdan eng to'g'ri sanaladi?
opts: Mavzuni kiritish, o'quvchilarda mavzuga oid bilimlarni faollashtirish va vazifa talablarini tushuntirish, zarur hollarda o'xshash topshiriqning namunaviy audio/video yozuvini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarga kerak bo'ladigan barcha yangi grammatik qoidalar va so'zlarni oldindan doskaga yozib, ularni mexanik mashqlar orqali yodlatish
O'quvchilarni darhol guruhlarga bo'lib, ulardan hech qanday ko'rsatmasiz mustaqil ravishda yakuniy hisobotni yozishni talab qilish
Topshiriq bajarib bo'linganidan so'ng o'quvchilar yo'l qo'ygan barcha nutqiy xatolarni doskada tahlil qilib berish
explanation: Jane Willis TBLT modelida Pre-task bosqichining asosiy maqsadi — o'quvchilarni vazifaga tayyorlash, mavzuga oid konseptual va lug'aviy bilimlarni (schemata) faollashtirish hamda topshiriq maqsadini aniq tushuntirishdir. Bu bosqichda grammatikani mexanik o'rgatish TBLT tamoyillariga zid.
mnemonic: Pre-task = Schemata faollashtirish + Maqsad va namunani ko'rsatish.

q: Jamshid o'z darsida TBLT Task Cycle (Topshiriq sikli) bosqichini tashkil etmoqda. O'quvchilar guruhda muammoni hal qilishdi va endi o'z natijalarini butun sinfga og'zaki taqdimot qilishlari kerak. Taqdimotdan oldingi 'Planning' (Rejalashtirish) bosqichida o'qituvchining asosiy roli nimadan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Sinfdagi barcha o'quvchilarni to'xtatib, frontal usulda taqdimot uchun yagona majburiy matn shablonini diktovka qilish
O'quvchilarga hisobot matnini tuzish va nutqni sayqallashda maslahatchi (language advisor) sifatida yordam berish hamda aniqlik (accuracy) ustida ishlashlariga ko'maklashish
O'quvchilarning har bir grammatik xatosini darhol to'xtatib tuzatish va baho qo'yish
Jarayonga umuman aralashmasdan, keyingi dars materiallarini tayyorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lish
explanation: Task Cycle ichidagi Planning bosqichida o'quvchilar erkin muloqotdan (fluency) o'z nutqini rasmiy taqdimotga moslashtirish (accuracy) tomon harakat qiladilar. O'qituvchi bu paytda maslahatchi bo'lib, til birliklarini to'g'ri tanlashga ko'maklashadi.
mnemonic: Planning bosqichi = Maslahatchi o'qituvchi + Aniqlik (accuracy) va tuzilishga tayyorgarlik.

q: Metodbirlashma yig'ilishida Nilufar an'anaviy PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production) modeli bilan TBLT o'rtasidagi farqni tushuntirib bermoqchi. Quyidagi tahlillardan qaysi biri TBLT ning mohiyatini eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ifodalaydi?
opts: TBLT modelida o'quvchilar hech qachon guruhda ishlamaydi, PPPda esa doimo juftlikda ishlanadi
PPP faqat muloqotga qaratilgan, TBLT esa faqat qat'iy grammatik qoidalarni yodlatishga xizmat qiladi
PPP til shaklini oldindan belgilab, uni mashq qildirsa, TBLTda muloqot birlamchi bo'lib, til vositalari (language focus) topshiriq ehtiyojidan kelib chiqqan holda dars oxirida tahlil qilinadi
PPPda xatolar tuzatilmaydi, TBLTda esa o'qituvchi har bir noto'g'ri aytilgan so'z uchun darhol jarima qo'llaydi
explanation: PPP sintetik model bo'lib, til birliklari bo'laklarga ajratilib o'rgatiladi (Form -> Meaning -> Use). TBLT esa analitik yondashuv bo'lib, muloqot jarayonida yuzaga chiqqan til bo'shliqlari 'Language Focus' bosqichida tahlil qilinadi.
mnemonic: PPP = Avval qoida, keyin muloqot; TBLT = Avval muloqot va vazifa, keyin til tahlili.

q: Robert Gagne tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan "9 ta ta'limiy hodisa" modeliga binoan, darsning eng birinchi bosqichida o'qituvchi qaysi didaktik harakatni amalga oshirishi shart?
opts: O'quvchilarga darhol 10 savolli mustaqil yozma ish tarqatib, baholashni boshlash.
O'quvchilarning diqqatini jalb qilish (Gain attention) — qiziqarli savol, kutilmagan vizual stimul yoki muammoli vaziyat orqali faol diqqatni uyg'otish.
Darslikdagi qoidani ovoz chiqarib o'qishni buyurish va konspekt qildirish.
Uyga vazifani daftarlarga yozdirish va keyingi haftadagi nazorat ishini e'lon qilish.
explanation: Gagne modelining 1-hodisasi "Gain attention" (Diqqatni jalb qilish)dir. O'quvchilarning idrok kanallari ochilmasdan turib maqsadni e'lon qilish yoki yangi material berish samarasiz bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Gagne 1-qadam: Diqqatni jalb qil (Gain Attention) -> keyin maqsadni tushuntir.

q: Farhod o'quv dasturiga TBLT topshiriqlarini kiritishda Nunan tasnifiga ko'ra 'Real-world (target) task' va 'Pedagogical task' farqini tahlil qilmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 'Pedagogical task' (pedagogik topshiriq) hisoblanadi?
opts: Xorijiy mehmonxona resepsheniga qo'ng'iroq qilib, xona bron qilish bo'yicha real suhbat qurish
O'quvchining internet orqali real aviakompaniya saytidan Toshkent-London reysiga chipta band qilishi
O'quvchining haqiqiy xalqaro do'konga buyurtma berish uchun rasmiy elektron xat jo'natishi
O'quvchilarning ikkita bir-biridan farqli rasmlar orasidagi 7 ta farqni bir-biriga ko'rsatmasdan, faqat savol-javob orqali topishi (Spot the differences)

In protocols such as BB84, information is encoded onto single photon polarization states. According to the Heisenberg uncertainty principle and the no-cloning theorem, any eavesdropper attempting to intercept, measure, or duplicate the quantum states irrevocably perturbs their quantum superposition, introducing detectable quantum bit error rates (QBER) between the legitimate communicants. If the observed QBER exceeds an established threshold, the transmission is aborted. However, physical implementations suffer from side-channel attacks, such as detector blinding, exploiting discrepancies between theoretical mathematical proofs and physical hardware limitations."

refractory
recalcitrant
pliant

q: Bobur TBLT darsida 'Decision-making task' (qaror qabul qilish topshirig'i) o'tkazmoqda. 4 nafar nomzoddan faqat bittasini kosmik ekspeditsiyaga tanlab olish kerak. Bunday topshiriq o'quvchilarda qaysi kognitiv va muloqot ko'nikmalarini faollashtiradi?
opts: Qoidalarni qat'iy yodlash va intonatsiyasiz o'qish
Matndan raqamlarni mexanik qidirib topish
Lug'atdan yangi so'zlarning sinonimlarini ko'chirish
Bahslashish, dalillar keltirish (justification), taqqoslash va kelishuvga erishish (negotiation of meaning)
explanation: Decision-making topshiriqlari Bloom taksonomiyasining Baholash (Evaluation) va Tahlil (Analysis) darajalarini ishga soladi. O'quvchilar o'z pozitsiyasini himoya qiladi va ma'noni muzokara qiladi (negotiation of meaning).
mnemonic: Decision-making = Fikrni dalillash + Muzokara (Negotiation of meaning) + Konsensus.

q: Umida o'quvchilarga "Shahrimizga kelgan xorijiy sayyohlar uchun bir kunlik eng qulay marshrutni rejalashtirish" mavzusida TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) darsini o'tmoqda. J. Willis modeli bo'yicha u 'Pre-task' (Topshiriqdan oldingi) bosqichida qaysi pedagogik harakatni amalga oshirishi metodik jihatdan eng to'g'ri sanaladi?
opts: Mavzuni kiritish, o'quvchilarda mavzuga oid bilimlarni faollashtirish va vazifa talablarini tushuntirish, zarur hollarda o'xshash topshiriqning namunaviy audio/video yozuvini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarga kerak bo'ladigan barcha yangi grammatik qoidalar va so'zlarni oldindan doskaga yozib, ularni mexanik mashqlar orqali yodlatish
O'quvchilarni darhol guruhlarga bo'lib, ulardan hech qanday ko'rsatmasiz mustaqil ravishda yakuniy hisobotni yozishni talab qilish
Topshiriq bajarib bo'linganidan so'ng o'quvchilar yo'l qo'ygan barcha nutqiy xatolarni doskada tahlil qilib berish
explanation: Jane Willis TBLT modelida Pre-task bosqichining asosiy maqsadi — o'quvchilarni vazifaga tayyorlash, mavzuga oid konseptual va lug'aviy bilimlarni (schemata) faollashtirish hamda topshiriq maqsadini aniq tushuntirishdir. Bu bosqichda grammatikani mexanik o'rgatish TBLT tamoyillariga zid.
mnemonic: Pre-task = Schemata faollashtirish + Maqsad va namunani ko'rsatish.

q: Otabek o'z darsida TBLT Task Cycle (Topshiriq sikli) bosqichini tashkil etmoqda. O'quvchilar guruhda muammoni hal qilishdi va endi o'z natijalarini butun sinfga og'zaki taqdimot qilishlari kerak. Taqdimotdan oldingi 'Planning' (Rejalashtirish) bosqichida o'qituvchining asosiy roli nimadan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Sinfdagi barcha o'quvchilarni to'xtatib, frontal usulda taqdimot uchun yagona majburiy matn shablonini diktovka qilish
O'quvchilarga hisobot matnini tuzish va nutqni sayqallashda maslahatchi (language advisor) sifatida yordam berish hamda aniqlik (accuracy) ustida ishlashlariga ko'maklashish
O'quvchilarning har bir grammatik xatosini darhol to'xtatib tuzatish va baho qo'yish
Jarayonga umuman aralashmasdan, keyingi dars materiallarini tayyorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lish
explanation: Task Cycle ichidagi Planning bosqichida o'quvchilar erkin muloqotdan (fluency) o'z nutqini rasmiy taqdimotga moslashtirish (accuracy) tomon harakat qiladilar. O'qituvchi bu paytda maslahatchi bo'lib, til birliklarini to'g'ri tanlashga ko'maklashadi.
mnemonic: Planning bosqichi = Maslahatchi o'qituvchi + Aniqlik (accuracy) va tuzilishga tayyorgarlik.

q: Ingliz tili o'qituvchisi geografiya o'qituvchisi bilan hamkorlikda "Global iqlim o'zgarishi va Orol dengizi fojiasi" mavzusida integratsiyalashgan dars loyihalashtirdi. Unda til o'rganish fanning mazmuni (geografiya) bilan uzviy integratsiya qilindi. Ushbu yondashuv zamonaviy ta'limda nima deb ataladi?
opts: Audio-Lingual Method — dialoglarni mexanik yod olish va takrorlash.
Grammar-Translation Method — grammatik-tarjima usuli orqali matnni so'zma-so'z o'girish.
CLIL (Content and Language Integrated Learning) — fan va tilni integratsiyalashgan holda o'qitish.
Suggestopedia — musiqiy ohang ostida relaksatsiya holatida yodlash.
explanation: CLIL yondashuvida ikkinchi til mustaqil fan sifatida emas, balki boshqa bir fan (geografiya, biologiya, tarix) mazmunini o'rganish vositasi sifatida qo'llaniladi va o'quvchida ham fan mazmuni, ham til kompetentsiyasi bir vaqtda rivojlanadi.
mnemonic: CLIL = Fan mazmuni (Content) + Til (Language) integratsiyasi.

q: Metodbirlashma yig'ilishida Zarina an'anaviy PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production) modeli bilan TBLT o'rtasidagi farqni tushuntirib bermoqchi. Quyidagi tahlillardan qaysi biri TBLT ning mohiyatini eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ifodalaydi?
opts: TBLT modelida o'quvchilar hech qachon guruhda ishlamaydi, PPPda esa doimo juftlikda ishlanadi
PPP faqat muloqotga qaratilgan, TBLT esa faqat qat'iy grammatik qoidalarni yodlatishga xizmat qiladi
PPP til shaklini oldindan belgilab, uni mashq qildirsa, TBLTda muloqot birlamchi bo'lib, til vositalari (language focus) topshiriq ehtiyojidan kelib chiqqan holda dars oxirida tahlil qilinadi
PPPda xatolar tuzatilmaydi, TBLTda esa o'qituvchi har bir noto'g'ri aytilgan so'z uchun darhol jarima qo'llaydi
explanation: PPP sintetik model bo'lib, til birliklari bo'laklarga ajratilib o'rgatiladi (Form -> Meaning -> Use). TBLT esa analitik yondashuv bo'lib, muloqot jarayonida yuzaga chiqqan til bo'shliqlari 'Language Focus' bosqichida tahlil qilinadi.
mnemonic: PPP = Avval qoida, keyin muloqot; TBLT = Avval muloqot va vazifa, keyin til tahlili.

q: Sherzod o'quv dasturiga TBLT topshiriqlarini kiritishda Nunan tasnifiga ko'ra 'Real-world (target) task' va 'Pedagogical task' farqini tahlil qilmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 'Pedagogical task' (pedagogik topshiriq) hisoblanadi?
opts: Xorijiy mehmonxona resepsheniga qo'ng'iroq qilib, xona bron qilish bo'yicha real suhbat qurish
O'quvchining internet orqali real aviakompaniya saytidan Toshkent-London reysiga chipta band qilishi
O'quvchining haqiqiy xalqaro do'konga buyurtma berish uchun rasmiy elektron xat jo'natishi
O'quvchilarning ikkita bir-biridan farqli rasmlar orasidagi 7 ta farqni bir-biriga ko'rsatmasdan, faqat savol-javob orqali topishi (Spot the differences)
explanation: Pedagogik topshiriq (Pedagogical task) real hayotda aynan uchramasa-da, real muloqot ko'nikmalarini (savol berish, taqqoslash, tushuntirish) sinf xonasida shakllantirish uchun maxsus loyihalashtirilgan sun'iy o'quv vazifasidir.
mnemonic: Pedagogical task = Sinf ichidagi maxsus muloqot mashqi; Target task = Real hayotiy amaliyot.

q:
Choose the grammatically correct inverted structure to complete the sentence:

*"Under no circumstances _____ to divulge confidential client data without explicit judicial authorisation."*
explanation:
Tahlil: Ingliz tili oliy grammatikasi (C1/C2) qoidalariga ko'ra, berilgan jumla maxsus sintaktik konstruksiyani talab qiladi. Gap boshida inkor yoki cheklovchi yuklama, ergash gapli inversion, shart mayli yoki bo'lingan gap (cleft sentence) qo'llanganda, odatiy so'z tartibi o'zgaradi va yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi (subject-auxiliary inversion). (Negative prepositional phrases placed in front position ('Under no circumstances') require subject-auxiliary inversion: auxiliary verb ('are') + subject ('employees') + participle ('permitted').)
To'g'ri javob: "are employees permitted" varianti barcha sintaktik talablarga (yordamchi fe'l, asosiy fe'l shakli, zamon va shaxs moslashuviga) to'liq javob berib, rasmiy akademik me'yorni to'liq ta'minlaydi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Negative Fronting: 'Under no circumstances' + AUXILIARY + SUBJECT.

q: Kamola TBLT darsida 'Language Focus' (Tahlil va amaliyot) bosqichini o'tkazmoqda. O'quvchilar topshiriqni bajarib, hisobot berib bo'lishdi. Bu bosqichda o'qituvchining eng maqbul vazifasi nima?
opts: Topshiriq jarayonida o'quvchilar ishlatgan yoki qiynalgan aniq til tuzilmalari, ifodalar va xatoliklarni matn va audio kontekstida tahlil qilish hamda amaliyotda mustahkamlash
Yangi boshqa bir grammatik mavzuni noldan tushuntirib, uyga 50 ta mashq berish
O'quvchilarga hech narsa tushuntirmasdan darsni yakunlash
O'quvchilarning shaxsiyatiga tegadigan qattiq tanqidiy mulohazalar bildirish
explanation: Willis modeli bo'yicha 'Language Focus' bosqichi o'quvchilar topshiriq davomida duch kelgan real leksik-grammatik tuzilmalarni ongli tahlil qilish (analysis) va mustahkamlash (practice) uchun ajratiladi.
mnemonic: Language Focus = Topshiriqdan kelib chiqqan til vositalarini ongli tahlil qilish.

q: Sardor sinfda TBLT ning 'Jigsaw' (mozaika) turidagi topshirig'ini qo'lladi. Har bir guruh a'zosiga umumiy hikoyaning faqat bittadan parchasi berildi. Ular bir-birlarining qog'oziga qaramasdan butun voqeani tiklashlari kerak. Ushbu topshiriqning kommunikativ qiymati nimada?
opts: O'quvchilarga matnni mustaqil tarjima qilish qulay bo'ladi
Haqiqiy axborot almashinuvi (Information gap) va o'zaro ikki tomonlama bog'liqlikni (Two-way task) vujudga keltiradi
O'qituvchiga darsda dam olish imkoniyatini yaratadi
O'quvchilar orasida raqobatni kuchaytirib, ularni bir-biri bilan gaplashmaslikka undaydi
explanation: Jigsaw topshiriqlari 'two-way information gap' yaratadi: hech bir o'quvchi to'liq ma'lumotga ega emas, yakuniy natijaga faqat faol muloqot va barcha a'zolar o'z qismini og'zaki yetkazishi orqaligina erishiladi.
mnemonic: Jigsaw Task = 2 tomonlama axborot bo'shlig'i (Two-way info gap) va muqarrar hamkorlik.

q: Gulbahor o'quvchilarga 'maktab hovlisini ko'kalamzorlashtirish loyihasi' bo'yicha TBLT darsini o'tdi. O'quvchilar loyihani yaratishdi, byudjetni hisoblashdi va taqdimot qilishdi. Rod Ellis tasnifiga ko'ra, topshiriqning (task) 'mashq'dan (exercise) asosiy ajralib turuvchi mezoni qaysi?
opts: Topshiriq faqat yozma ravishda bajarilishi
Topshiriqda faqat to'g'ri zamon shakllarini qo'yish talab etilishi
Asosiy e'tibor til shakliga emas, balki pragmatik ma'noga va aniq nom-lingvistik natijaga (non-linguistic outcome) qaratilganligi
Barcha gaplar faqat o'qituvchi tomonidan baholanishi
explanation: Rod Ellis bo'yicha topshiriq (task) mezonlari: 1) Ma'no birlamchi; 2) Axborot bo'shlig'i bor; 3) O'quvchi o'z til resurslariga tayanadi; 4) Aniq nom-lingvistik natija (masalan, loyiha, qaror, reja) mavjud.
mnemonic: Task vs Exercise: Task = Ma'no + O'z resurslari + Aniq hayotiy natija.

q: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga murakkab analitik hisobot yozishni topshirishdan oldin: 1) tayyor namunani tahlil qildirdi; 2) jumlalarni bog'lovchi tayyor qoliplar (sentence starters) berdi; 3) guruhda birgalikda reja tuzdirdi; 4) shundan keyingina mustaqil yozishga o'tdi. Ushbu metodik qo'llab-quvvatlash tizimi qanday nomlanadi?
opts: Summativ nazorat — o'quvchining yakuniy xatolarini hisobga oluvchi qat'iy tekshiruv.
Avtoritar yo'naltirish — o'quvchining erkin fikrlashini qat'iy cheklovchi tsenzura mexanizmi.
Ko'r-ko'rona nusxalash — mustaqil izlanishni butunlay inkor etuvchi shablon usuli.
Skaffolding (Scaffolding) — yangi ko'nikmani o'zlashtirish jarayonida beriladigan va asta-sekin olib tashlanadigan vaqtinchalik pedagogik ko'mak.
explanation: Jerome Bruner tomonidan kiritilgan "Skaffolding" tushunchasi o'quvchi vazifani mustaqil bajara oladigan darajaga yetgunga qadar o'qituvchi tomonidan ko'rsatiladigan tizimli vaqtinchalik yordam (namunalar, qoliplar, bosqichma-bosqich yo'riqnomalar)ni anglatadi.
mnemonic: Skaffolding = Vaqtinchalik pedagogik ko'mak (zina); mustaqil bo'lgach olib tashlanadi.

q: Madina 9-sinf o'quvchilariga 'Past Perfect vs Past Simple' mavzusini o'tishda Test-Teach-Test (TTT) modelini tanladi. Ushbu metodik tanlovning eng asosiy pedagogik maqsadi va afzalligi nimada?
opts: Dastlabki 'Test' orqali o'quvchilar mavzuni qanchalik bilishini diagnostika qilish va faqat ular qiynalayotgan jihatlariga qaratilgan maqsadli dars ('Teach') o'tish
Dars boshidayoq o'quvchilarga qoniqarsiz baho qo'yish orqali ularni darsda qattiq intizom saqlashga majburlash
O'qituvchining darsga tayyorgarlik ko'rmasdan, butun 45 daqiqani faqat mustaqil test yechishga ajratishi
O'quvchilarga yangi mavzuni tushuntirmasdan, ularni nazorat imtihoniga tayyorlash
explanation: Test-Teach-Test (TTT) modeli o'quvchilarning mavjud bilim darajasini oldindan aniqlash (diagnostika) imkonini beradi. Natijada o'qituvchi o'quvchilar allaqachon biladigan qoidalarni qayta tushuntirib vaqt yo'qotmaydi, balki aniqlangan bo'shliqlar (gaps) ustida ishlaydi.
mnemonic: TTT = Test (Diagnostika) -> Teach (Bo'shliqni to'ldirish) -> Test (Mustahkamlash).

q:
Read the academic passage:
"In statistical thermodynamics, Maxwell's demon was originally formulated as a thought experiment challenging the second law of thermodynamics. James Clerk Maxwell envisioned a microscopic entity operating a frictionless trapdoor between two gas compartments, sorting fast molecules into one chamber and slow molecules into the other, seemingly reducing entropy without expending mechanical work. The resolution of this paradox, formalized by Rolf Landauer and Charles Bennett, hinges on information physics: acquiring information about molecular velocities does not violate entropy, but erasing that information from the demon's physical memory register incurs an irreducible thermodynamic cost. Landauer's principle establishes that erasing one bit of logical information dissipates at least kT ln(2) Joules of heat into the environment."

How did information theory ultimately resolve the Maxwell's demon thermodynamic paradox?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"In statistical thermodynamics, Maxwell's demon was originally formulated as a thought experiment challenging the second law of thermodynamics. James Clerk Maxwell envisioned a microscopic entity operating a frictionless trapdoor between two gas compartments, sorting fast molecules into one chamber and slow molecules into the other, seemingly reducing entropy without expending mechanical work. The resolution of this paradox, formalized by Rolf Landauer and Charles Bennett, hinges on information physics: acquiring information about molecular velocities does not violate entropy, but erasing that information from the demon's physical memory register incurs an irreducible thermodynamic cost. Landauer's principle establishes that erasing one bit of logical information dissipates at least kT ln(2) Joules of heat into the environment."

How did information theory ultimately resolve the Maxwell's demon thermodynamic paradox?
opts: By demonstrating that fast and slow gas molecules possess identical kinetic energy distributions.
By proving that erasing the demon's stored information dissipates an unavoidable minimum quantity of heat.
By establishing that microscopic trapdoors generate infinite friction during mechanical operation.
By showing that the second law of thermodynamics does not apply to microscopic gas chambers.
options: By demonstrating that fast and slow gas molecules possess identical kinetic energy distributions.
By proving that erasing the demon's stored information dissipates an unavoidable minimum quantity of heat.
By establishing that microscopic trapdoors generate infinite friction during mechanical operation.
By showing that the second law of thermodynamics does not apply to microscopic gas chambers.
explanation:
Tahlil: Paradoks Landauer prinsipi orqali hal qilindi: demonning xotirasidagi ma'lumotni o'chirish (erasing information) atrof-muhitga kamida kT ln(2) miqdorda issiqlik ajratilishini talab qiladi, bu esa umumiy entropiyaning oshishini ta'minlaydi.
To'g'ri javob: Demon xotirasidagi ma'lumotni o'chirish muqarrar ravishda minimal miqdorda issiqlik ajratishini isbotlash orqali.
Chalg'ituvchilar: molekulalar bir xil kinetik energiyaga ega emas; ishqalanish cheksiz emas; termodinamika ikkinchi qonuni mikroolamda ham amal qiladi.
Eslatma: Landauer prinsipi: axborotni o'chirish = issiqlik ajralishi (Information erasure dissipates heat).
mnemonic: Landauer principle = Information erasure restores thermodynamic entropy balance.

q: Rustam Jeremy Harmerning 'ESA' (Engage, Study, Activate) konsepsiyasiga tayanib dars o'tmoqda. U quyidagi ketma-ketlikni qo'lladi: Qiziqtirish (Engage) -> Erkin faoliyat (Activate) -> Grammatik tahlil (Study) -> Yangi muloqot (Activate) -> Yana tahlil (Study). Ushbu dars modeli Harmer tasnifiga ko'ra qaysi dars tuzilishiga kiradi?
opts: Straight Arrows (To'g'ri o'qlar) an'anaviy dars modeli
Patchwork (Yamoqli/Murakkab uyg'unlashgan) dars modeli
Boomerang (Qaytuvchi bumerang) dars modeli
Audio-Lingual mexanik dars modeli
explanation: Harmer ESA tizimida 3 xil modelni ajratadi: 1) Straight Arrows (E -> S -> A); 2) Boomerang (E -> A -> S -> A); 3) Patchwork (E -> A -> S -> A -> S -> A kabi bir nechta bosqichlar erkin va uyg'un ravishda almashib keladi).
mnemonic: Patchwork ESA = Bir necha bor E, S, A elementlarining erkin almashinib takrorlanishi.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Synthetic lethality offers a sophisticated conceptual paradigm in targeted cancer therapeutics. In oncology, two genes are synthetically lethal if the mutation of either gene alone maintains cellular viability, whereas the simultaneous disruption of both genes leads directly to cell death. A paradigmatic application involves BRCA-mutated tumors, which lack homologous recombination (HR) DNA repair pathways. Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors selectively block single-strand DNA break repair, converting un-repaired lesions into double-strand breaks during replication. In normal somatic cells with functional BRCA pathways, these lesions are resolved; however, in BRCA-deficient malignant cells, the collapse of both repair mechanisms triggers catastrophic genomic instability and apoptosis."

What is the therapeutic mechanism underlying synthetic lethality in BRCA-mutated tumor cells treated with PARP inhibitors?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"Synthetic lethality offers a sophisticated conceptual paradigm in targeted cancer therapeutics. In oncology, two genes are synthetically lethal if the mutation of either gene alone maintains cellular viability, whereas the simultaneous disruption of both genes leads directly to cell death. A paradigmatic application involves BRCA-mutated tumors, which lack homologous recombination (HR) DNA repair pathways. Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors selectively block single-strand DNA break repair, converting un-repaired lesions into double-strand breaks during replication. In normal somatic cells with functional BRCA pathways, these lesions are resolved; however, in BRCA-deficient malignant cells, the collapse of both repair mechanisms triggers catastrophic genomic instability and apoptosis."

What is the therapeutic mechanism underlying synthetic lethality in BRCA-mutated tumor cells treated with PARP inhibitors?
opts: Repairing both DNA strands simultaneously restores normal non-malignant cell division in tumors.
Completely stimulating PARP enzymes prevents single-strand lesions from forming during replication.
Targeting a secondary DNA repair pathway causes fatal genomic collapse exclusively in cells already deficient in homologous repair.
Inactivating homologous recombination in healthy somatic cells prevents chemotherapy toxicity.
options: Repairing both DNA strands simultaneously restores normal non-malignant cell division in tumors.
Completely stimulating PARP enzymes prevents single-strand lesions from forming during replication.
Targeting a secondary DNA repair pathway causes fatal genomic collapse exclusively in cells already deficient in homologous repair.
Inactivating homologous recombination in healthy somatic cells prevents chemotherapy toxicity.
explanation:
Tahlil: Sintetik letallikning mohiyati shundaki, saraton hujayralarida allaqachon bitta ta'mirlash yo'li (BRCA / HR) ishdan chiqqan. PARP ingibitorlari ikkinchi yo'lni (bir zanjirli uzilishlarni tuzatish) to'sib qo'yadi va faqat saraton hujayralarida ikkala yo'l ham yo'qligi sababli halokatli genomik buzilish sodir bo'ladi.
To'g'ri javob: Ikkinchi ta'mirlash yo'lini to'sib qo'yish orqali allaqachon nuqsonga ega hujayralarda o'limga olib keluvchi genomik beqarorlikni keltirib chiqarish.
Chalg'ituvchilar: ikkala zanjirni tiklash saratonda o'lim keltirmaydi; PARP fermentlarini rag'batlantirish emas, ingibitsiya qilish aytilgan; sog'lom hujayralarda HR ni to'xtatish xavfli.
Eslatma: Sintetik letallik = 1-yo'l yo'q + 2-yo'l to'sildi -> saraton hujayrasi o'ladi.
mnemonic: Synthetic lethality = One inherent defect + one pharmacological block = selective death.

(The counterfactual past inverted conditional without 'if' uses 'Had it not been for [Noun Phrase]', corresponding to 'If it had not been for'.)

Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Type 3 Inverted Conditional: 'Had it not been for' = past hypothetical.

q:

"The cosmic distance ladder relies on standard candles—astronomical objects of known intrinsic luminosity—to calibrate extragalactic distances. Cepheid variable stars provide the pivotal intermediate rung, governed by Henrietta Leavitt's period-luminosity relation. By measuring a Cepheid's pulsation period, astronomers deduce its absolute magnitude and compare it to its apparent brightness to derive distance. However, systematic errors in distance estimates arise from metallicity variations and interstellar dust extinction. If dust extinction along the line of sight is improperly modeled, stellar brightness is artificially attenuated, causing astronomers to overestimate the galaxy's distance and skewing Hubble constant calculations."

What error occurs if interstellar dust extinction is underestimated when observing Cepheid variables?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Directed evolution mimics natural selection in vitro to engineer biocatalysts with novel industrial capabilities, bypassing the limitations of rational enzyme design. While rational engineering requires comprehensive knowledge of protein tertiary structure and catalytic transition states, directed evolution relies on cycles of random mutagenesis, recombinant shuffling, and high-throughput screening. By iteratively isolating mutant variants displaying enhanced thermostability or enantioselectivity, researchers traverse fitness landscapes that computational models fail to predict. Nevertheless, the methodology is constrained by screening throughput: exploring the astronomical combinatorial space of a typical 300-amino-acid polypeptide—which spans 20 raised to the 300th power permutations—remains physically impossible, necessitating intelligent library generation strategies."

What is the primary operational constraint of directed evolution highlighted by the author?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Active galactic nuclei (AGNs), powered by accretion disks surrounding supermassive black holes, exert profound feedback on their host galaxies. As infalling baryonic matter heats to millions of degrees, conservation of angular momentum drives the generation of relativistic collimated plasma jets that penetrate deep into the circumgalactic medium. These jets deposit immense mechanical energy, heating cold molecular gas reservoirs and expelling them beyond the galactic halo. Because cold gas condensation is the prerequisite for star formation, this AGN-driven 'kinetic quenching' effectively starves the host galaxy of the raw material required for stellar birth, explaining why the most massive elliptical galaxies in the modern universe appear dormant and 'red and dead'."

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Thermonuclear supernovae (Type Ia) serve as cosmological yardsticks because they originate from the thermonuclear destruction of carbon-oxygen white dwarfs reaching the Chandrasekhar limit of approximately 1.4 solar masses. However, observational discrepancies in peak luminosities have forced astrophysicists to question the classical single-degenerate progenitor model, where a white dwarf accretes mass from a non-degenerate companion star. Many observed supernovae exhibit no hydrogen signatures in late-time spectra, pointing toward a double-degenerate scenario involving the catastrophic merger of two white dwarfs. Because the combined mass of two merging dwarfs can substantially exceed the Chandrasekhar threshold (super-Chandrasekhar mass), uncorrected assumptions about standard progenitor masses introduce systematic uncertainties into dark energy measurements."

Why does the double-degenerate merger model introduce uncertainties into dark energy cosmological calculations?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy represents a frontier in personalized immunotherapy, genetically reprogramming autologous T lymphocytes to express synthetic receptors targeting specific tumor antigens, such as CD19 in B-cell leukemias. Despite spectacular remissions in hematological malignancies, translating CAR T-cells to solid tumors remains hindered by the hostile tumor microenvironment (TME). Solid tumors construct immunosuppressive stroma rich in regulatory T cells, myeloid-derived suppressor cells, and inhibitory ligands like PD-L1. Furthermore, aberrant tumor vasculature generates regions of severe hypoxia and acidosis that impair CAR T-cell metabolic fitness, while dense extracellular fibrotic matrices physically exclude engineered lymphocytes from penetrating tumor cores."

What primary obstacle impedes the therapeutic efficacy of CAR T-cell therapies in solid tumors compared to blood cancers?

"The discovery that terminally differentiated somatic cells can be reprogrammed into induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) via the ectopic expression of four transcription factors—Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc (the Yamanaka factors)—shattered the developmental dogma that cellular differentiation is a unidirectional trajectory. "Programmed ribosomal frameshifting (PRF) is an unconventional translational mechanism utilized predominantly by retroviruses and coronaviruses to regulate viral polyprotein stoichiometry. During elongation, the translating ribosome encounters a specific heptanucleotide 'slippery sequence' followed downstream by a rigid RNA secondary structure, typically an RNA pseudoknot. The physical mechanical resistance exerted by the pseudoknot stalls the translocating ribosome over the slippery sequence, inducing the ribosome to slip backward by one nucleotide (-1 PRF) or forward (+1 PRF) into an alternative reading frame. This elegant biophysical stalling enables viral genomes to encode overlapping, functionally distinct proteins from a single polycistronic mRNA transcript."

What primary role does the downstream RNA pseudoknot play during ribosomal frameshifting?

Neutrinos exist in three distinct flavor eigenstates (electron, muon, tau) which are non-trivial quantum linear superpositions of three discrete mass eigenstates, mathematically formalized by the Pontecorvo-Maki-Nakagawa-Sakata (PMNS) mixing matrix. Eslatma: Type 2 Inverted Conditional: 'Were it not for' = present hypothetical state.
