q:
Read the academic passage:
"RNA interference (RNAi) operates as a conserved eukaryotic gene-silencing mechanism orchestrated by small non-coding RNA molecules. Double-stranded precursor RNAs are processed into small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) or microRNAs (miRNAs) by the endoribonuclease Dicer. These duplexes are subsequently incorporated into the RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC), where the Argonaute endonuclease unwinds the duplex, retaining the 'guide strand' while expelling the 'passenger strand'. While synthetic siRNAs mediate targeted endonucleolytic mRNA cleavage through perfect sequence complementarity, endogenous miRNAs typically bind with imperfect complementarity within the 3-prime untranslated region (UTR) of target transcripts, directing translational repression and deadenylation rather than direct cleavage."

How does the regulatory action of endogenous microRNAs typically differ from synthetic siRNAs?

opts: Should you require

(Tentative conditional inversion for open future conditions replaces 'If you require' or 'If you should require' with 'Should you require'.)
To'g'ri javob: "Should you require" varianti barcha sintaktik talablarga (yordamchi fe'l, asosiy fe'l shakli, zamon va shaxs moslashuviga) to'liq javob berib, rasmiy akademik me'yorni to'liq ta'minlaydi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Formal Tentative Conditional: 'Should you require' replaces 'If you need'.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has deconstructed traditional histology by resolving transcriptional heterogeneity at single-cell resolution. Historic bulk transcriptomics homogenized tissue samples, averaging gene expression across millions of cells and masking rare stem cell niches, transitional oncogenic phenotypes, and infiltrative immune subsets. By encapsulating individual cells into nanoliter droplets containing barcoded micro-beads, scRNA-seq captures unique mRNA transcripts tagged with cell barcodes and Unique Molecular Identifiers (UMIs). While this granularity exposes novel cellular atlases and lineage branching trajectories, it introduces severe technical hurdles, including high 'dropout' rates—where low-abundance transcripts fail to be captured—requiring sophisticated imputation algorithms to decipher true biological signals from technical stochasticity."

Chalg'ituvchilar: shtrix-kodli munchoqlar mavjud; to'qimalarni bir xillashtirish bulk usuliga tegishli; o'lchovni qisqartirish imkonsiz emas.
Eslatma: Dropout rates = scRNA-seq ning asosiy texnik cheklovi.
mnemonic: scRNA-seq dropout = Low-abundance transcripts require statistical imputation.

q:
Select the correct form to complete the historical analysis:

*"_____ the catastrophic trajectory of the hurricane twenty-four hours earlier, municipal authorities could have evacuated the barrier islands."*
opts: Did meteorologists anticipate
Were meteorologists anticipated
Had meteorologists anticipated
Should meteorologists have anticipated
explanation:
Tahlil: Ingliz tili oliy grammatikasi (C1/C2) qoidalariga ko'ra, berilgan jumla maxsus sintaktik konstruksiyani talab qiladi. Gap boshida inkor yoki cheklovchi yuklama, ergash gapli inversion, shart mayli yoki bo'lingan gap (cleft sentence) qo'llanganda, odatiy so'z tartibi o'zgaradi va yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi (subject-auxiliary inversion). (Inverted third conditional: 'Had meteorologists anticipated' replaces 'If meteorologists had anticipated'.)
To'g'ri javob: "Had meteorologists anticipated" varianti barcha sintaktik talablarga (yordamchi fe'l, asosiy fe'l shakli, zamon va shaxs moslashuviga) to'liq javob berib, rasmiy akademik me'yorni to'liq ta'minlaydi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Third Conditional Inversion: 'Had + Subject + Past Participle'.

q: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga tayyor qoidani yodlashni buyurmasdan, ularga 10 ta turli xil gap namunalarini taqdim etdi va guruhda muhokama qilib, qoidani o'quvchilarning o'zlari mustaqil kashf etishlariga sharoit yaratdi. Ushbu yondashuv qaysi ta'lim nazariyasiga asoslangan?

Bixeviorizm (Rag'batlantirish va mexanik mashqlar orqali odat shakllantirish nazariyasi).
Klassik qat'iy dogmatizm (O'qituvchi aytgan tayyor formulani so'zsiz takrorlash).
Konnektivizm faqat sun'iy intellekt serverlariga ulanish nazariyasi.
explanation: Konstruktivizm nazariyasida o'quvchi bilimlarni passiv qabul qiluvchi idish emas, balki faol izlanish, tajriba va induktiv tahlil orqali o'z ongida yangi bilimlarni mustaqil quruvchi (konstruktsiya qiluvchi) subyekt hisoblanadi.

Recent psychiatric neuropathology suggests that aberrant, hyperactive synaptic pruning during adolescence—driven by over-expression of complement variants like C4A—leads to excessive loss of dendritic spines in the prefrontal cortex, predisposing individuals to schizophrenia and cognitive fragmentation."

What neurobiological hypothesis connects complement proteins to the pathophysiology of schizophrenia?

explanation:
Tahlil: Matnda shizofreniya patologiyasi bo'yicha gipoteza keltirilgan: komplement oqsillari (masalan, C4A) ning haddan tashqari faollashuvi mikrogliya hujayralarining prefrontal qobiqdagi sog'lom dendrit o'simtalarini haddan tashqari ko'p yutib yuborishiga (excessive pruning) olib keladi.
To'g'ri javob: Komplementning haddan tashqari ifodalanishi prefrontal qobiqda mikrogliya tomonidan dendritlarning ortiqcha yo'qotilishiga sabab bo'ladi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: mikrogliya aloqasini to'xtatmaydi; komplement yetishmovchiligi proliferatsiya qilmaydi; glial o'smalarga aylantirmaydi.
Eslatma: Hyperactive pruning = haddan tashqari sinaptik tozalash -> shizofreniya xavfi.

q: Bobur PPP modelining 'Presentation' bosqichida yangi til birligini kiritmoqda. Scrivener ta'limotiga ko'ra, Presentation bosqichining muvaffaqiyati nimaga bog'liq?
opts: O'quvchilarga birdaniga 50 ta yangi qoidani jadval ko'rinishida berishga
O'qituvchining dars davomida uzluksiz o'zbek tilida grammatik terminlarni tahlil qilishiga
O'quvchilar dars boshidan oxirigacha faqat jim o'tirib eshitishiga
Til birligining ma'nosi (Meaning), shakli (Form) va talaffuzi (Pronunciation) aniq kontekstda, tushunarli vizual yoki situatsion misollar bilan ochib berilishiga
explanation: Presentation bosqichida MFP (Meaning, Form, Pronunciation) qoidasi muqaddasdir: avval ma'no kontekstda ochiladi, so'ng shakli ko'rsatiladi, talaffuzi drill qilinadi.
mnemonic: MFP = Meaning (Ma'no) + Form (Shakl) + Pronunciation (Talaffuz).

q: Umida ingliz tili darsida o'quvchisi Shahzodning inglizcha suhbat paytida ma'lum bir so'zni (masalan, 'corkscrew' - po'kakochqich) unutib qo'yganida, dovdirab qolmasdan: "It's a metal tool you use to open a bottle of wine" deb tushuntirib ketganini kuzatdi. Canale va Swain modeli bo'yicha Shahzod qaysi kompetentsiyani namoyish etdi?
opts: Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence) — muloqotdagi uzilishlarni parafraza va aylanma ifodalar orqali bartaraf etish qobiliyati
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence) — so'zlarning morfemik tuzilishini tahlil qilish
Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic competence) — rasmiy va norasmiy uslubni farqlash
Diskursiv kompetentsiya (Discourse competence) — murakkab matnlar orasida bog'lovchilarni qo'llash
explanation: Canale & Swain (1980) modelida Strategik kompetentsiya muloqot jarayonidagi to'siqlar yoki so'z esdan chiqqanda parafraza (circumlocution), imo-ishora yoki muqobil so'zlar orqali muloqotni saqlab qolish mahoratidir.
mnemonic: Strategik kompetentsiya = So'z topilmaganda parafraza orqali muloqotni qutqarish.

q: Otabek o'quvchilarga xalqaro konferensiyada nufuzli professorga murojaat qilish odobini o'rgatmoqda. O'quvchi professorga "Hey mate, give me your slides!" deb murojaat qilganda, o'qituvchi buni uslubiy xato deb tuzatdi. Tilning vaziyatga, ijtimoiy maqomga va madaniy kontekstga mos kelishini ta'minlovchi kompetentsiya qaysi?
opts: Tashkiliy-sintaktik kompetentsiya (Organizational competence)
Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic / Pragmatic competence)
Fonologik kompetentsiya (Phonological competence)
Leksik-mexanik kompetentsiya (Lexical mechanical competence)
explanation: Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya til birliklarini ijtimoiy-madaniy vaziyatga, so'zlovchilarning maqomi (register, politeness) va muloqot muhitiga mos ravishda to'g'ri tanlash va qo'llash qobiliyatidir.
mnemonic: Sotsiolingvistik = Vaziyat, maqom va madaniy me'yorga mos muloqot (Register & Politeness).

q: Zarina haqiqiy kommunikativ mashg'ulot (CLT activity) loyihalashtirmoqchi. Morrow va Johnson tamoyillariga ko'ra, mashg'ulot chinakam kommunikativ bo'lishi uchun unda qaysi uchta asosiy xususiyat mujassam bo'lishi shart?
opts: So'zma-so'z tarjima (Translation), matnni ifodali o'qish (Loud reading) va yozma diktant (Dictation)
Mexanik takrorlash (Drilling), qat'iy nazorat (Tight control) va grammatik tahlil (Grammar analysis)
Axborot bo'shlig'i (Information gap), tanlov erkinligi (Choice) va natijaviy qayta aloqa (Feedback / Communicative purpose)
O'qituvchining uzluksiz ma'ruzasi (High TTT), jimjitlik (Silence) va individual test (Testing)
explanation: Kommunikativ metodikaning 3 oltin tamoyili: 1) Information gap (bir o'quvchi bilgan narsani ikkinchisi bilmaydi); 2) Choice (o'quvchi qanday til vositalarini tanlashda erkin); 3) Feedback (muloqot maqsadi amalga oshgan-oshmaganligini anglash).
mnemonic: CLT Uchligi = Information Gap + Choice + Communicative Feedback.

q: Sherzod 11-sinf o'quvchisining inshosini tekshirar ekan, har bir gap alohida olinganda grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri tuzilgan bo'lsa-da, gaplar o'rtasida mantiqiy bog'liqlik (coherence) va bog'lovchi vositalar (cohesion) yetishmayotganini ko'rdi. O'quvchida qaysi kommunikativ kompetentsiya turi yetarlicha rivojlanmagan?
opts: Fonetik kompetentsiya (Phonetic competence)
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence)
Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence)
Diskursiv kompetentsiya (Discourse competence)
explanation: Diskursiv kompetentsiya — alohida gaplarni yaxlit, mantiqiy va mazmunan bog'langan (coherent & cohesive) og'zaki yoki yozma matn holiga keltirish qobiliyatidir.
mnemonic: Diskursiv kompetentsiya = Gaplarni yaxlit va mantiqiy matnga aylantirish (Cohesion & Coherence).

q: Kamola o'quvchilarda Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical / Linguistic competence)ni shakllantirishda an'anaviy yondashuvdan ko'ra zamonaviy CLT yondashuvini qo'llamoqda. Zamonaviy CLT da grammatika qanday o'rgatiladi?
opts: Qoidalarni shunchaki yodlash emas, balki til tuzilmalarini ma'no va muloqot ehtiyojlariga xizmat qiluvchi dinamik vosita sifatida kontekstda o'rganish (Grammaring / Form-Meaning-Use)
Faqat o'zbek tiliga tarjima qilish va yozma formulalarni yoddan so'rash
Grammatikani umuman o'rgatmaslik va e'tibordan chetda qoldirish
O'quvchilarga faqat qiyin istisno qoidalarni diktovka qilish
explanation: Diane Larsen-Freeman ta'riflaganidek, grammatika passiv bilim emas, balki faol 'grammaring' ko'nikmasidir. CLT da grammatika muloqot kontekstida, shakl (Form), ma'no (Meaning) va qo'llanish (Use) birligida o'zlashtiriladi.
mnemonic: Grammaring = Grammatika muloqot vositasi sifatida (Form, Meaning, Use).

q: Sardor darsda o'quvchilarni 'Role-play' (rol ijro etish) va 'Simulation' (simulyatsiya) faoliyatlariga jalb qildi. O'quvchilar aeroportda yo'qolgan yukni topish bo'yicha xodim bilan muzokara olib borishdi. Bunday mashg'ulotning eng katta kommunikativ ustunligi nima?
opts: Faqat qat'iy yozilgan ssenariyni so'zma-so'z xato qilmasdan yoddan aytish
O'quvchilarni real hayotiy ijtimoiy rollarga tayyorlash, emotsional xavfsiz muhitda muloqot tajribasini sinab ko'rish imkoniyati
O'qituvchining barcha o'quvchilar ustidan qat'iy nazoratini saqlab qolishi
Dars vaqtini tejash va yozma mashqlardan qochish
explanation: Rolli o'yinlar va simulyatsiyalar o'quvchilarga sinfdan tashqaridagi real vaziyatlarni modellashtirish, ijtimoiy-lingvistik rollarni o'zlashtirish va kutilmagan muloqot to'siqlarini yengish imkonini beradi.
mnemonic: Role-play & Simulation = Real hayotiy rollarni sinfda xavfsiz mashq qilish.

q: Gulbahor o'z sinfida 'Information-gap activity' o'tkazmoqda. O'quvchi A da ma'lumotlar jadvalining bir qismi bor, O'quvchi B da esa ikkinchi qismi. Ular bir-birlarining varaqlariga qaramasdan savol-javob orqali bo'shliqlarni to'ldirishadi. Nima uchun bu topshiriq an'anaviy savol-javobdan ustun?
opts: Chunki bu usulda o'quvchilar yozish ko'nikmasini umuman ishlatmaydi
Chunki o'qituvchi o'quvchilarning nima gaplashayotganini tushunmaydi
Chunki javob oldindan ma'lum emas; savol beruvchi ma'lumotga haqiqiy ehtiyoj sezadi, bu esa muloqotni sun'iylikdan xalos etadi
Chunki darsda shovqin bo'lmaydi va hamma alohida ishlaydi
explanation: Display question (javobi o'qituvchiga ma'lum savol)dan farqli ravishda, Information-gap mashg'ulotlarida Genuine/Referential questions (haqiqiy ma'lumot talab qiluvchi savollar) ishlatiladi, bu esa autentik muloqotni keltirib chiqaradi.
mnemonic: Information gap = Haqiqiy ma'lumotga ehtiyoj (Referential questions).

q: Azamat CLT darsida o'quvchilarning nutqiy xatolariga munosabat bildirish tamoyillarini belgilamoqda. Fluency (nutq ravonligi) bosqichida o'qituvchining eng to'g'ri pedagogik pozitsiyasi qanday bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Xato qilgan o'quvchiga darhol past baho qo'yish
Har bir fonetik yoki grammatik xato sodir bo'lishi bilanoq o'quvchi gapini to'xtatib, unga 5 marta to'g'ri shaklini takrorlatish
O'quvchilarning barcha xatolarini e'tiborsiz qoldirish va hech qachon xatolar ustida ishlamaslik

explanation: CLT da ravonlik (fluency) bosqichida muloqot jasorati va ma'no uzatish birlamchi bo'lib, o'qituvchi oraliqqa suqulib kirmaydi (non-intrusive monitoring). Kechiktirilgan qayta aloqa (delayed feedback) muloqot oqimini buzmaydi.
mnemonic: Fluency paytida = Interruption yo'q -> Delayed Feedback dars oxirida.

q: Lev Vygotskiyning "Yaqin rivojlanish hududi" (ZPD) kontseptsiyasiga muvofiq, dars rejasiga kiritiladigan o'quv topshiriqlarining optimal qiyinlik darajasi qanday bo'lishi kerak?

q:
Read the following dialogue between two football fans after their team loses a match:

*Fan A:* "I cannot believe the referee made that controversial penalty call!"
*Fan B:* "Well, business is business, and football is football."

How does Fan B’s tautological statement generate meaning in pragmatic discourse?
opts: By violating the Maxim of Quality, Fan B denies that football is an athletic sport.
By uttering a literal tautology containing zero new empirical information, Fan B flouts the Maxim of Quantity to implicate stoic acceptance of unavoidable realities.
By flouting the Maxim of Manner, Fan B attempts to speak in rhyming iambic pentameter.
By violating the Maxim of Relation, Fan B changes the subject to commercial corporate accounting.
explanation: A tautology ('football is football') is literally uninformative (flouting Quantity: provide informative data), forcing the hearer to infer a pragmatic implicature: that football inherently involves unpredictable flaws that must be philosophically accepted.
mnemonic: Tautology Implicature: Zero literal information forces an implicature of resignation.

q: O'qituvchi yangi dars uchun internetdan material tanlashda qaysi 4 ta asosiy mezonni birinchi navbatda tekshirishi kasbiy etika va didaktik talablarga mos keladi?

q:
Read the following exchange:

*Speaker A:* "Are you coming to Sarah’s birthday banquet tonight?"
*Speaker B:* "My child has a fever of forty degrees."

What type of conversational implicature does Speaker B produce?
opts: A conventional implicature: it is hardwired into the lexical semantics of the conjunction "and".
A generalized conversational implicature: it arises automatically from the sentence structure without requiring any contextual knowledge.
A particularized conversational implicature: its inferential calculation depends strictly on the specific local situational context of the question.
A semantic presupposition: it logically entails that children are forbidden from attending banquets.
explanation: A 'particularized' conversational implicature requires knowledge of the specific context (a child's fever prevents attending a party). A 'generalized' implicature arises independently of specific context (like 'a car' implicating not the speaker's own car).
mnemonic: Particularized Implicature: Dependent on the unique local situational context.

q: Alisher 11-sinf o'quvchisining inshosini tekshirar ekan, har bir gap alohida olinganda grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri tuzilgan bo'lsa-da, gaplar o'rtasida mantiqiy bog'liqlik (coherence) va bog'lovchi vositalar (cohesion) yetishmayotganini ko'rdi. O'quvchida qaysi kommunikativ kompetentsiya turi yetarlicha rivojlanmagan?
opts: Fonetik kompetentsiya (Phonetic competence)
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence)
Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence)
Diskursiv kompetentsiya (Discourse competence)
explanation: Diskursiv kompetentsiya — alohida gaplarni yaxlit, mantiqiy va mazmunan bog'langan (coherent & cohesive) og'zaki yoki yozma matn holiga keltirish qobiliyatidir.
mnemonic: Diskursiv kompetentsiya = Gaplarni yaxlit va mantiqiy matnga aylantirish (Cohesion & Coherence).

q: Nodira o'quvchilarda Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical / Linguistic competence)ni shakllantirishda an'anaviy yondashuvdan ko'ra zamonaviy CLT yondashuvini qo'llamoqda. Zamonaviy CLT da grammatika qanday o'rgatiladi?
opts: Qoidalarni shunchaki yodlash emas, balki til tuzilmalarini ma'no va muloqot ehtiyojlariga xizmat qiluvchi dinamik vosita sifatida kontekstda o'rganish (Grammaring / Form-Meaning-Use)
Faqat o'zbek tiliga tarjima qilish va yozma formulalarni yoddan so'rash
Grammatikani umuman o'rgatmaslik va e'tibordan chetda qoldirish
O'quvchilarga faqat qiyin istisno qoidalarni diktovka qilish
explanation: Diane Larsen-Freeman ta'riflaganidek, grammatika passiv bilim emas, balki faol 'grammaring' ko'nikmasidir. CLT da grammatika muloqot kontekstida, shakl (Form), ma'no (Meaning) va qo'llanish (Use) birligida o'zlashtiriladi.
mnemonic: Grammaring = Grammatika muloqot vositasi sifatida (Form, Meaning, Use).

q: Bekzod darsda o'quvchilarni 'Role-play' (rol ijro etish) va 'Simulation' (simulyatsiya) faoliyatlariga jalb qildi. O'quvchilar aeroportda yo'qolgan yukni topish bo'yicha xodim bilan muzokara olib borishdi. Bunday mashg'ulotning eng katta kommunikativ ustunligi nima?
opts: Faqat qat'iy yozilgan ssenariyni so'zma-so'z xato qilmasdan yoddan aytish
O'quvchilarni real hayotiy ijtimoiy rollarga tayyorlash, emotsional xavfsiz muhitda muloqot tajribasini sinab ko'rish imkoniyati
O'qituvchining barcha o'quvchilar ustidan qat'iy nazoratini saqlab qolishi
Dars vaqtini tejash va yozma mashqlardan qochish
explanation: Rolli o'yinlar va simulyatsiyalar o'quvchilarga sinfdan tashqaridagi real vaziyatlarni modellashtirish, ijtimoiy-lingvistik rollarni o'zlashtirish va kutilmagan muloqot to'siqlarini yengish imkonini beradi.
mnemonic: Role-play & Simulation = Real hayotiy rollarni sinfda xavfsiz mashq qilish.

q: O'qituvchi haftalik o'quv rejasini tuzib qo'ygan bo'lsa-da, chorshanba kungi darsda o'quvchilarning ko'pchiligi asosiy grammatik qoidani tushunmaganligini aniqladi. Professional o'qituvchi payshanba kungi dars rejasiga qanday yondashishi kerak?
opts: Dars jadvalini yirtib tashlab, chorak oxirigacha faqat diktant yozdirish.
Rejani o'zgartirish qat'iyan man etilganligi sababli, o'quvchilar tushunmaganiga qaramay yangi mavzuni reja bo'yicha boshlab ketaverish.
O'quvchilarga darsdan keyin o'zlari mustaqil repetitorga borib o'rganishni buyurish.
Rejaga moslashuvchanlik (flexibility) kiritib, yangi mavzuga o'tishni to'xtatish va o'zlashtirilmagan qism bo'yicha alternativ metodlar bilan qayta tushuntirish va amaliyot o'tkazish.
explanation: Dars rejasi doimo o'quvchilarning o'rganish ehtiyojlariga xizmat qilishi lozim (plan is a guide, not a straitjacket). Agar asosiy tushuncha o'zlashtirilmagan bo'lsa, uni to'g'irlamasdan keyingi mavzuga o'tish keyingi butun zanjirni uzib yuboradi.
mnemonic: Moslashuvchan reja: Tushunilmagan poydevor ustiga yangi qavat qurilmaydi.

q:
Read the sentence:

*"She is an investment banker, but she is exceptionally honest."*

What conventional implicature is carried by the coordinating conjunction *but* in this utterance?
opts: The speaker does not know the truth value of her profession.
All investment bankers are convicted criminal embezzlers.
She has resigned from her position at the investment bank.
There is an inherent contrast or unexpected clash between being an investment banker and being honest.
explanation: 'Conventional implicatures' are not calculated via the Cooperative Principle maxims; they are attached conventionally to specific lexical words (like 'but', 'even', 'yet', 'therefore'). 'But' conventionally implicates an unexpected contrast between the conjoined propositions.
mnemonic: Conventional Implicature: Attached directly to specific words ('but', 'even', 'yet').

q: Anderson va Krathwohl (2001) tomonidan qayta ko'rib chiqilgan Bloom taksonomiyasida kognitiv jarayonlar pastdan yuqoriga qaysi to'g'ri ketma-ketlikda joylashgan?
opts: Eslab qolish (Remember) -> Tushunish (Understand) -> Qo'llash (Apply) -> Tahlil qilish (Analyze) -> Baholash (Evaluate) -> Yaratish (Create).
Tushunish -> Eslab qolish -> Yaratish -> Baholash -> Tahlil qilish -> Qo'llash.
Qo'llash -> Tahlil qilish -> Eslab qolish -> Tushunish -> Yaratish -> Baholash.
Yaratish -> Baholash -> Tahlil qilish -> Qo'llash -> Tushunish -> Eslab qolish.
explanation: Taksonomiyaning qayta ko'rib chiqilgan zamonaviy ierarxiyasi: 1. Remember, 2. Understand, 3. Apply, 4. Analyze, 5. Evaluate, 6. Create (Yaratish eng yuqori cho'qqi).
mnemonic: Bloom zinapoyasi: Eslab qolish -> Tushunish -> Qo'llash -> Tahlil -> Baholash -> Yaratish.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"High-entropy alloys (HEAs) diverge fundamentally from traditional metallurgical design, which relies on a single principal solvent element lightly doped with minor alloying elements (such as carbon in iron for steel). HEAs incorporate five or more metallic elements in near-equimolar proportions. Counterintuitively, rather than precipitating into brittle intermetallic compounds, these mixtures form simple, single-phase solid solutions, stabilized by immense configurational entropy at elevated temperatures (Delta-S_conf = R ln(n)). The severe local lattice distortion arising from disparate atomic radii impedes dislocation mobility, granting HEAs exceptional yield strength, remarkable fracture toughness at cryogenic temperatures, and pronounced resistance to high-temperature creep and irradiation-induced swelling."

Why do high-entropy alloys form ductile single-phase solid solutions rather than brittle intermetallic phases?

opts: Their constituent elements possess identical atomic radii and electron configurations.
They consist of ninety percent iron with microscopic traces of other metallic elements.

The complete absence of dislocations allows crystal layers to slide without any mechanical friction.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Fast neutron reactors (FNRs) offer a closed fuel cycle capability fundamentally superior to standard thermal light-water reactors. Operating without neutron moderators like water or graphite, FNRs utilize un-moderated, high-energy neutrons to sustain fission. Crucially, these energetic neutrons can induce fission in abundant fertile isotopes like uranium-238 (which constitutes 99.3 percent of mined uranium), transmuting it into fissile plutonium-239. This 'breeding' process extracts over sixty times more energy per kilogram of mined uranium compared to open thermal cycles. Furthermore, fast neutrons can incinerate long-lived transuranic actinides (americium, curium, neptunium), drastically compressing the geological containment duration of nuclear waste from hundreds of thousands of years to several centuries."

What ecological and radiological advantage do fast neutron reactors provide regarding nuclear waste management?

q: O'qituvchi dars boshida mavzuni e'lon qilishdan oldin o'quvchilarga qiziqarli detektiv jumboq ko'rsatdi va ularni jumboq yechimini topishga chorladi. Madeline Hunter dars modeliga ko'ra, bu bosqich qanday nomlanadi?
opts: Independent Practice (Mustaqil amaliyot) — o'quvchilarning o'qituvchisiz yolg'iz ishlash bosqichi.

Closure (Darsni yakunlash) — uyga vazifa berish va xayrlashish.

explanation: Madeline Hunter modelidagi Anticipatory Set (yoki zamonaviy tilda "Hook") o'quvchilar diqqatini darsga qaratish, ularning ichki qiziqishini uyg'otish va mavzuga ko'prik tashlash uchun xizmat qiladi.

q: Quyida keltirilgan dars maqsadlaridan qaysi biri haqiqiy "o'quvchiga yo'naltirilgan" (student-centered) mezonlarga to'liq javob beradi?

q:
A great stillness enveloped the ship. The barque lay motionless upon a sheet of obsidian water, trapped within the stifling embrace of the Gulf of Siam. The sails hung in lifeless folds from the yards, grey and dead in an atmosphere that seemed devoid of oxygen. Day after day, the sun rose like a drop of molten copper, blazing through a brass sky that pressed down upon the decks like the lid of an oven. Below, the crew lay stricken with fever, their groans filtering through the open skylights. The second mate looked at me with sunken, glassy eyes that had ceased to expect deliverance; in his feverish delirium, he muttered that the old captain's curse had chained us forever to this shadow line between youth and death.

What psychological state does the second mate's belief in the 'old captain's curse' reveal?

Chalg'ituvchilar: bezgak parazitlarining ilmiy tahlili emas; sug'urtani pasaytirish hiylasi emas; hazil-mutoyiba emas.

mnemonic: Captain's curse = Feverish despair creates occult fatalism to explain indifferent suffering.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Flat optics enabled by metasurfaces represents a departure from bulk refractive optics. Traditional optical lenses rely on phase accumulation across macroscopic geometric propagation distances, making them inherently bulky and subject to chromatic and spherical aberrations. Metasurfaces, conversely, utilize planar arrays of sub-wavelength dielectric or metallic nanostructures (meta-atoms) to abruptly introduce discontinuous phase shifts via the geometric Berry phase. By engineering the geometry, orientation, and spatial arrangement of each meta-atom, an ultra-thin flat metasurface can focus multiple wavelengths across a shared focal plane, condensing multi-element lens assemblies into a flat, lithographically manufacturable chip."

According to the passage, how do flat metasurface lenses overcome the physical bulk of traditional refractive lenses?

What conventional implicature does the focus particle *even* introduce into the discourse?
opts: The chief engineer was the least likely person to fail to decipher the log, making his failure extraordinary and counter-expectational.
The chief engineer was physically absent from the crash investigation.
The flight log was composed in an alien extraterrestrial language.
The chief engineer is incompetent and should be immediately dismissed.
explanation: 'Even' conventionally implicates that the mentioned entity is at the extreme end of an expectation scale, making the proposition counter-expectational or surprising.
mnemonic: Conventional 'Even': Implicates the extreme end of an expectation scale.

q: Mohira o'z sinfida 'Information-gap activity' o'tkazmoqda. O'quvchi A da ma'lumotlar jadvalining bir qismi bor, O'quvchi B da esa ikkinchi qismi. Ular bir-birlarining varaqlariga qaramasdan savol-javob orqali bo'shliqlarni to'ldirishadi. Nima uchun bu topshiriq an'anaviy savol-javobdan ustun?
opts: Chunki bu usulda o'quvchilar yozish ko'nikmasini umuman ishlatmaydi
Chunki o'qituvchi o'quvchilarning nima gaplashayotganini tushunmaydi
Chunki javob oldindan ma'lum emas; savol beruvchi ma'lumotga haqiqiy ehtiyoj sezadi, bu esa muloqotni sun'iylikdan xalos etadi
Chunki darsda shovqin bo'lmaydi va hamma alohida ishlaydi
explanation: Display question (javobi o'qituvchiga ma'lum savol)dan farqli ravishda, Information-gap mashg'ulotlarida Genuine/Referential questions (haqiqiy ma'lumot talab qiluvchi savollar) ishlatiladi, bu esa autentik muloqotni keltirib chiqaradi.
mnemonic: Information gap = Haqiqiy ma'lumotga ehtiyoj (Referential questions).

explanation:
Tahlil: Ingliz tili oliy grammatikasi (C1/C2) qoidalariga ko'ra, berilgan jumla maxsus sintaktik konstruksiyani talab qiladi. Gap boshida inkor yoki cheklovchi yuklama, ergash gapli inversion, shart mayli yoki bo'lingan gap (cleft sentence) qo'llanganda, odatiy so'z tartibi o'zgaradi va yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi (subject-auxiliary inversion). (In locative inversion (fronted prepositional phrase of place), FULL inversion occurs (the intransitive verb precedes the entire subject): 'lay the crumbling stone ruins'. Auxiliary 'did' is ungrammatical here.)
To'g'ri javob: "lay the crumbling stone ruins" varianti barcha sintaktik talablarga (yordamchi fe'l, asosiy fe'l shakli, zamon va shaxs moslashuviga) to'liq javob berib, rasmiy akademik me'yorni to'liq ta'minlaydi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Locative Full Inversion: Place phrase + Intransitive Verb + Full Subject (no auxiliary 'do').

O'quvchilarning barcha xatolarini e'tiborsiz qoldirish va hech qachon xatolar ustida ishlamaslik

q: Dilnoza ingliz tili darsida o'quvchisi Shahzodning inglizcha suhbat paytida ma'lum bir so'zni (masalan, 'corkscrew' - po'kakochqich) unutib qo'yganida, dovdirab qolmasdan: "It's a metal tool you use to open a bottle of wine" deb tushuntirib ketganini kuzatdi. Canale va Swain modeli bo'yicha Shahzod qaysi kompetentsiyani namoyish etdi?
opts: Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence) — muloqotdagi uzilishlarni parafraza va aylanma ifodalar orqali bartaraf etish qobiliyati
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence) — so'zlarning morfemik tuzilishini tahlil qilish
Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic competence) — rasmiy va norasmiy uslubni farqlash

How is this utterance interpreted under Gricean pragmatics?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Quantum annealing systems, such as those pioneered by D-Wave, are specialized adiabatic quantum computing architectures engineered to resolve combinatorial optimization problems by finding the ground state of an Ising spin glass Hamiltonian. The processor begins in a simple, known ground state of an initial quantum Hamiltonian and slowly transitions toward a problem Hamiltonian encoding the optimization objective. According to the adiabatic theorem, if the transition occurs sufficiently slowly, the system remains in its ground state, yielding the global optimum. However, critics note that quantum annealing is not equivalent to universal gate-model quantum computation: it cannot execute quantum error correction, nor does it provide universal polynomial speedups across arbitrary algorithmic domains."

What fundamental limitation differentiates quantum annealers from universal gate-model quantum computers?

q:
Read the academic passage:
"The long-term potentiation (LTP) of excitatory glutamatergic synapses represents the cellular substrate of learning and memory consolidation. Induction of early-phase LTP occurs when postsynaptic depolarization expels magnesium ions (Mg2+) from the pore of NMDA receptors, permitting an influx of calcium ions (Ca2+). This calcium transient triggers calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII) activation, which mobilizes AMPA receptors from intracellular endosomal reserves and inserts them into the postsynaptic density. The insertion of additional AMPA receptors increases synaptic sensitivity to subsequent glutamate release, physically strengthening synaptic transmission. Late-phase LTP, conversely, requires de novo gene transcription and protein synthesis, recruiting CREB phosphorylation to stabilize dendritic spine enlargement."

What immediate molecular event triggers the insertion of additional AMPA receptors into the postsynaptic density?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"The long-term potentiation (LTP) of excitatory glutamatergic synapses represents the cellular substrate of learning and memory consolidation. Induction of early-phase LTP occurs when postsynaptic depolarization expels magnesium ions (Mg2+) from the pore of NMDA receptors, permitting an influx of calcium ions (Ca2+). This calcium transient triggers calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII) activation, which mobilizes AMPA receptors from intracellular endosomal reserves and inserts them into the postsynaptic density. The insertion of additional AMPA receptors increases synaptic sensitivity to subsequent glutamate release, physically strengthening synaptic transmission. Late-phase LTP, conversely, requires de novo gene transcription and protein synthesis, recruiting CREB phosphorylation to stabilize dendritic spine enlargement."

What immediate molecular event triggers the insertion of additional AMPA receptors into the postsynaptic density?
opts: Immediate expulsion of all intracellular calcium ions through active potassium pumps.
The permanent blockage of NMDA receptors by extracellular magnesium ion deposits.
Activation of CaMKII driven by a calcium ion influx through unblocked NMDA receptor channels.
De novo CREB protein synthesis occurring entirely within presynaptic axon terminals.
options: Immediate expulsion of all intracellular calcium ions through active potassium pumps.
The permanent blockage of NMDA receptors by extracellular magnesium ion deposits.
Activation of CaMKII driven by a calcium ion influx through unblocked NMDA receptor channels.
De novo CREB protein synthesis occurring entirely within presynaptic axon terminals.
explanation:
Tahlil: Matnda ko'rsatilishicha, NMDA retseptorlaridan magniy chiqib ketishi natijasida kalsiy oqimi kiradi, bu CaMKII fermentini faollashtiradi va qo'shimcha AMPA retseptorlarining postsinaptik membranaga kiritilishini (insertion) boshqaradi.
To'g'ri javob: Ochiq NMDA kanallaridan kirgan kalsiy oqimi orqali CaMKII fermentining faollashishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: kalsiyning chiqarib yuborilishi emas; NMDA ning doimiy to'silishi teskari; CREB sintezi darhol emas, kechki fazada bo'ladi.
Eslatma: LTP induksiyasi: NMDA ochiladi -> Ca2+ kiradi -> CaMKII faollashadi -> AMPA kiritiladi.
mnemonic: LTP sequence: NMDA unblock -> Ca2+ influx -> CaMKII activation -> AMPA insertion.

explanation: Diane Larsen-Freeman ta'riflaganidek, grammatika passiv bilim emas, balki faol 'grammaring' ko'nikmasidir. CLT da grammatika muloqot kontekstida, shakl (Form), ma'no (Meaning) va qo'llanish (Use) birligida o'zlashtiriladi.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Deep brain stimulation (DBS) utilizes chronically implanted electrodes delivering high-frequency electrical pulses to deep subcortical nuclei, most notably the subthalamic nucleus (STN) or internal globus pallidus, providing profound symptomatic relief for Parkinson's disease. Historically, DBS was presumed to act as a functional lesion by locally silencing overactive neurons. However, electrophysiological recording reveals that DBS exerts complex circuit-level neuromodulation. While high-frequency pulses suppress pathological low-frequency beta-band oscillations (13-30 Hz) linked to bradykinesia and rigidity, they simultaneously stimulate axonal efferents, regularizing irregular firing patterns across the basal ganglia-thalamocortical loop and restoring functional information flow."

How has the conceptual understanding of the therapeutic mechanism of Deep Brain Stimulation evolved?

q:
A passenger who has just survived a catastrophic plane crash that severed both wings and destroyed the engines steps onto the tarmac and remarks:

*"Well, that was not the smoothest flight I have ever experienced."*

What pragmatic figure is utilized here, and which maxim does it flout?
opts: Tautology: it flouts the Maxim of Manner by repeating identical grammatical predicates.
Hyperbole: it flouts the Maxim of Quantity by exaggerating the smoothness of the landing.
Litotes (ironic understatement): it flouts the Maxim of Quality to generate an implicature of extreme peril through a negated contrary.
Metaphor: it violates the Maxim of Relation by describing flight aviation mechanics.
explanation: Litotes (understatement by denying the contrary: 'not the smoothest') flouts the Maxim of Quality to produce a wry, darkly humorous implicature regarding how terrifying the flight was.
mnemonic: Litotes Flouting: Understating a catastrophe through negation flouts Quality.

The north wind swept across the barren Yorkshire moors, rattling the casements of Thornfield Hall with wild fury. Standing before Mr. Rochester in the library, Jane drew herself up to her full, modest height. 'Do you think, because I am poor, obscure, plain, and little, I am soulless and heartless? You think wrong!—I have as much soul as you,—and full as much heart! And if God had gifted me with some beauty and much wealth, I should have made it as hard for you to leave me, as it is now for me to leave you. I am not talking to you now through the medium of custom, conventionalities, nor even of mortal flesh;—it is my spirit that addresses your spirit; just as if both had passed through the grave, and we stood at God's feet, equal,—as we are!'

What core philosophical assertion underpins Jane Eyre's passionate confrontation with Rochester?

options: Inherent spiritual and moral equality between individuals transcends socioeconomic class, gender, and appearance.
Wealthy aristocrats should be immediately executed and their private country estates converted into public barns.
Women must passively accept social inferiority and defer to male judgment in all romantic affairs.
Physical external beauty is the absolute divine requirement for entering the kingdom of heaven.

explanation:
Tahlil: Jeyn Eyrning (Jane Eyre) Rochester bilan to'qnashuvidagi eng asosiy falsafiy da'vosi — insonlarning ma'naviy va ruhiy tengligidir. Kambag'allik, xunuklik yoki oddiy tabaqaga mansublik insonning qalbini qashshoq qilmaydi; Xudo oldida ham, axloqiy jihatdan ham har bir inson teng huquqli va teng qadr-qimmatga ega ruhiy mavjudotdir.
To'g'ri javob: Insonlarning tug'ma ma'naviy va axloqiy tengligi ijtimoiy tabaqa, jins va tashqi ko'rinishdan ustun turishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: aristokratlarni qatl qilish emas; ayollarning bo'ysunishi kerakligi emas; jismoniy go'zallik jannatga kirish sharti emas.
Eslatma: Jane Eyre moral equality = Radical assertion that inner spiritual worth dissolves Victorian class and gender hierarchies.
mnemonic: Jane Eyre equality = Spirit speaks to spirit: inviolable moral equality across social ranks.

mnemonic: Metaphor as Quality Flouting: Literal biological falsehood triggers trait mapping.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Photonic quantum computing manipulates single photons traveling through integrated optical waveguides as quantum bits. Photons possess immense decoherence resistance at room temperature and traverse telecommunication networks at the speed of light, making them ideal carriers of quantum information. However, because photons do not naturally interact with one another, implementing two-qubit entangling gates—such as Controlled-NOT (CNOT)—demands non-linear interactions. In linear optical quantum computing (LOQC), non-linearity is generated non-deterministically through measurement and quantum interference (the Hong-Ou-Mandel effect). To overcome the probabilistic nature of these gates, modern architectures employ cluster-state measurement-based quantum computing, using continuous-variable squeezed light and multiplexed optical loops."

What fundamental physical hurdle must photonic quantum computing overcome to execute entangling two-qubit logic gates?

q: Jamshid o'z sinfidagi o'quvchilar tanaffusda ingliz tilida kundalik mavzularda juda ravon va erkin suhbatlashishini (masalan, futbol, ob-havo), biroq CLIL darsida tarixiy manbalarni tahlil qilish va ilmiy xulosa yozishda jiddiy qiynalayotganini kuzatdi. Jim Cummins nazariyasiga ko'ra, bu holat qanday tushuntiriladi?
opts: O'quvchilarda CALP yuqori darajada, lekin BICS umuman mavjud emas
O'quvchilarda BICS (Basic Interpersonal Communicative Skills) yaxshi shakllangan, biroq CALP (Cognitive Academic Language Proficiency) hali yetarli darajada rivojlanmagan
O'quvchilar ikkinchi tilni o'rganishda 'Silent period' (jimlik davri) bosqichida turibdi
O'quvchilarda fonologik eshitish qobiliyati to'liq yo'qolgan
explanation: Jim Cummins nazariyasiga binoan, BICS (kundalik norasmiy muloqot tili) 1-2 yilda shakllanadi, ammo CALP (akademik va ilmiy tafakkur tili) chuqur shakllanishi uchun 5-7 yil talab etiladi. CLIL aynan CALP ni rivojlantirishga xizmat qiladi.

q: Nilufar CLIL darsida o'quvchilar uchun til vositalarini tanlashda Do Coyle'ning 'Language Triptych' (Til triptixi) modelidan foydalanmoqda. Ushbu modelga ko'ra 'Language FOR learning' tushunchasi nimani anglatadi?
opts: O'quvchilar topshiriq bajarish davomida kutilmaganda ehtiyoj sezadigan yangi so'zlar
Fanning asosiy lug'at boyligi va atamalari (masalan: fotosintez, xlorofill)
O'quvchilarga dars jarayonida vazifalarni bajarish uchun zarur bo'ladigan funksional muloqot tili (bahslashish, savol berish, guruhda taklif kiritish, xulosa yasash)
Faqat o'qituvchining sinfni boshqarish uchun aytadigan buyruqlari
explanation: Language Triptych 3 qismdan iborat: 1) Language OF learning (mavzuviy atamalar); 2) Language FOR learning (darsda ishlash, bahslashish, fikr bildirish uchun zarur funksional til); 3) Language THROUGH learning (o'rganish jarayonida kashf qilinadigan yangi til birliklari).
mnemonic: Language Triptych: OF (Atamalar), FOR (Faoliyat tili), THROUGH (Yangi kashf qilingan til).

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs), including NANOGrav and the European PTA, detect nanohertz-frequency gravitational waves by monitoring millisecond pulsars across the Milky Way. Millisecond pulsars act as ultra-stable celestial clocks, sweeping beams of electromagnetic radiation across Earth with timing precision rivaling atomic clocks. When a gravitational wave traverses the galaxy, it cyclically stretches and compresses spacetime between the pulsars and Earth, inducing correlated perturbations in pulse arrival times across the sky. The definitive signature—formalized by the Hellings-Downs curve—is a characteristic quadrupolar angular correlation pattern: the degree of timing correlation between pulsar pairs depends strictly upon their angular separation in the sky."

What constitutes the definitive observational proof that pulsar timing perturbations are caused by gravitational waves?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs), including NANOGrav and the European PTA, detect nanohertz-frequency gravitational waves by monitoring millisecond pulsars across the Milky Way. When a gravitational wave traverses the galaxy, it cyclically stretches and compresses spacetime between the pulsars and Earth, inducing correlated perturbations in pulse arrival times across the sky. The definitive signature—formalized by the Hellings-Downs curve—is a characteristic quadrupolar angular correlation pattern: the degree of timing correlation between pulsar pairs depends strictly upon their angular separation in the sky."

What constitutes the definitive observational proof that pulsar timing perturbations are caused by gravitational waves?
opts: A complete cessation of all electromagnetic radio pulses emitted by millisecond pulsars.
The spontaneous acceleration of pulsars toward the supermassive black hole at the galactic center.
An identical, uniform time delay observed across every single star regardless of celestial position.
A quadrupolar correlation pattern in pulse arrival times conforming to the Hellings-Downs curve.
options: A complete cessation of all electromagnetic radio pulses emitted by millisecond pulsars.
The spontaneous acceleration of pulsars toward the supermassive black hole at the galactic center.
An identical, uniform time delay observed across every single star regardless of celestial position.
A quadrupolar correlation pattern in pulse arrival times conforming to the Hellings-Downs curve.
explanation:
Tahlil: Pulsar timing massivlarida gravitatsion to'lqinning borligini tasdiqlovchi qat'iy dalil — Hellings-Downs egri chizig'iga mos keluvchi kvadrupol korrelyatsiya modelidir (quadrupolar angular correlation pattern).
To'g'ri javob: Hellings-Downs egri chizig'iga mos keluvchi signallarning fazoviy kvadrupol korrelyatsiya shakli.
Chalg'ituvchilar: pulsatsiyaning to'xtashi emas; tezlashuv emas; barcha yulduzlarda bir xil kechikish bo'lmaydi (burchak masofasiga bog'liq).
Eslatma: Hellings-Downs egri chizig'i = nanogers gravitatsion to'lqinlarning asosiy 'barmoq izi'.
mnemonic: Hellings-Downs curve = Quadrupolar signature confirms gravitational wave background.

q:
Read the meteorological advisory:

*"It is possible that torrential flash floods will strike the valley tonight."*

Under the modal scale <certain, probable, possible>, what does this advisory pragmatically implicate?
opts: It is not certain that flash floods will strike the valley tonight.
Flash floods are guaranteed to submerge the entire valley beyond all doubt.
Meteorological radars have failed and cannot detect any moisture.
The atmospheric moisture has completely dissipated into desert air.
explanation: Choosing the lowest scalar item 'possible' generates the upper-bounded scalar implicature 'possible, but not certain'.
mnemonic: Scalar Modals: 'Possible' scalar implicates 'not certain / not guaranteed'.

q:
Two parents are sitting in the parlor with their four-year-old child. One parent says to the other:

*"I believe it is time to transport our small dependent to the S-L-E-E-P chamber."*

Why did the speaker spell out the word and use clinical jargon, and which maxim is flouted?
opts: The speaker violates the Maxim of Quality because the child is actually twenty-five years old.
The speaker flouts the Maxim of Manner (avoid obscurity) to generate an implicature for the adult while intentionally preventing the child from decoding the message.
The speaker opts out of the Cooperative Principle because spelling is illegal in domestic settings.
The speaker infringes the Maxim of Relation by discussing chamber architecture.
explanation: Spelling out words or using obscure jargon in front of eavesdroppers flouts Manner ('be clear and avoid obscurity') with the deliberate pragmatic purpose of communicating with one hearer while keeping another in the dark.
mnemonic: Manner Flouting (Spelling): Deliberate obscurity to exclude a third-party hearer.

q: Dars rejasida "dars maromi" (Pacing) tushunchasi nimani anglatadi va u nima uchun o'ta muhim?
opts: Maktab qo'ng'irog'ining ovoz balandligi va jaranglash davomiyligi.
O'qituvchining sinf xonasi bo'ylab daqiqasiga necha qadam bosishi kerakligini belgilovchi qat'iy me'yor.
Dars davomida o'quvchilarga qo'yib beriladigan fon musiqasining daqiqadagi zarbalar soni (BPM).
Darsdagi turli faoliyat turlarining tezligi, almashinish ritmi va vaqtga mutanosibligi; marom juda tez bo'lsa o'quvchilar tushunmay qoladi, juda sekin bo'lsa zerikish va intizomsizlik boshlanadi.
explanation: Dars maromi (Pacing) — mashg'ulotlarning oqilona dinamikasi. Faoliyatlar o'z vaqtida o'zgarib turishi, o'quvchilarning toliqishi yoki aksincha orqada qolib ketishining oldini olish darsning muvaffaqiyat garovidir.
mnemonic: Dars maromi (Pacing) = Didaktik tezlik va faoliyatlar almashinuv balansi.

Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.

Do'sti bilan xaritaga qarab yo'nalishni ko'rsatish (surat va imo-ishoralar bilan)

q: Jasur CLIL darsida baholash tizimini ishlab chiqmoqda. CLIL metodikasida o'quvchilarning natijalarini baholashda qaysi oltin tamoyilga qat'iy amal qilinishi kerak?
opts: Har qanday kichik imlo xatosi uchun o'quvchining fan bo'yicha to'plagan barcha ballari nolga tenglashtirilishi shart

Baholashda fan mazmuni (content) va til ko'nikmalari (language) alohida mezonlar asosida differentsial baholanishi lozim; o'quvchining ilmiy g'oyasi to'g'ri bo'lsa, kichik grammatik xatolar uchun fan bahosi pasaytirilmasligi kerak
CLIL darslarida faqat grammatika baholanadi, fan mazmuni umuman hisobga olinmaydi
Faqat darsda eng baland ovozda gapirgan o'quvchilargagina a'lo baho qo'yiladi
explanation: CLIL baholashida fan mazmuni va til alohida baholanishi shart. Agar o'quvchi ilmiy g'oyani to'g'ri tushungan va ifodalay olgan bo'lsa, til xatolari fan mazmunini bilish darajasiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmasligi kerak.
mnemonic: CLIL Baholash = Fan mazmuni va Til alohida mezonlar bilan baholanadi.

q: Shahnoza 'Hard CLIL' va 'Soft CLIL' yondashuvlarini solishtirmoqda. Agar maktabda geografiya fani to'liq ingliz tilida geografiya o'qituvchisi tomonidan o'tilsa va asosiy maqsad fan dasturini o'zlashtirish bo'lsa, bu qaysi modelga kiradi?
opts: Direct Translation Method
Soft CLIL (Yumshoq CLIL) — ingliz tili darsi ichida kichik fanga oid mavzu kiritiladi
Hard CLIL (Qattiq/Chuqurlashtirilgan CLIL) — fanning o'zi xorijiy tilda o'qitiladi va dars jadvalida fan sifatida turadi
Grammar Immersion
explanation: Hard CLIL da fanning o'zi (masalan, fizika yoki biologiya) to'liq xorijiy tilda fan o'qituvchisi tomonidan o'qitiladi. Soft CLIL da esa ingliz tili darsiga fanga oid kichik mavzu integratsiya qilinadi.
mnemonic: Hard CLIL = Fan darsining o'zi L2 da; Soft CLIL = Til darsiga fan mavzusini olib kirish.

Darslikdagi hayvonlar nomlarini alifbo tartibida yozib chiqish

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs) are recombinant protein constructs engineered to overcome tumor immune evasion. Cytotoxic T lymphocytes normally require major histocompatibility complex class I (MHC-I) presentation to recognize tumor antigens; malignant cells frequently down-regulate MHC-I to escape surveillance. A BiTE molecule consists of two single-chain variable fragments (scFvs) connected by a flexible peptide linker: one arm binds specifically to a tumor-associated surface antigen, while the other binds to the CD3 epsilon subunit of the T-cell receptor complex. By physically tethering cytotoxic T cells directly to tumor cells, BiTEs bypass MHC restriction, inducing immunological synapse formation, perforin and granzyme secretion, and target cell lysis."

According to the passage, how do BiTE molecules overcome tumor evasion mediated by MHC-I down-regulation?
question:

"Bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs) are recombinant protein constructs engineered to overcome tumor immune evasion. A BiTE molecule consists of two single-chain variable fragments (scFvs) connected by a flexible peptide linker: one arm binds specifically to a tumor-associated surface antigen, while the other binds to the CD3 epsilon subunit of the T-cell receptor complex. By physically tethering cytotoxic T cells directly to tumor cells, BiTEs bypass MHC restriction, inducing immunological synapse formation, perforin and granzyme secretion, and target cell lysis."

According to the passage, how do BiTE molecules overcome tumor evasion mediated by MHC-I down-regulation?
opts: By directly cross-linking T-cell CD3 receptors to tumor surface antigens, bypassing the need for MHC-I presentation.
By forcing tumor cells to permanently overexpress MHC-I proteins on their outer membrane.
By eliminating all cytotoxic T lymphocytes from peripheral blood circulation.
By neutralizing all perforin and granzyme enzymes produced by natural killer cells.
options: By directly cross-linking T-cell CD3 receptors to tumor surface antigens, bypassing the need for MHC-I presentation.
By forcing tumor cells to permanently overexpress MHC-I proteins on their outer membrane.
By eliminating all cytotoxic T lymphocytes from peripheral blood circulation.
By neutralizing all perforin and granzyme enzymes produced by natural killer cells.
explanation:
Tahlil: Saraton hujayralari ko'pincha MHC-I ni yo'qotib immun nazoratidan qochadi. BiTE molekulasi esa bir tomoni bilan o'sma antigeniga, ikkinchi tomoni bilan T-hujayraning CD3 retseptoriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lanib, MHC-I taqdimotiga ehtiyoj qoldirmaydi.
To'g'ri javob: T-hujayra CD3 retseptorlarini o'sma antigeniga bevosita bog'lab, MHC-I ga ehtiyojni chetlab o'tish orqali.
Chalg'ituvchilar: MHC-I ni majburan ko'paytirmaydi; T-limfotsitlarni yo'qotmaydi; perforinni zararsizlantirmaydi.
Eslatma: BiTE = MHC-I ni chetlab o'tib, T-hujayrani o'smaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lovchi ko'prik.
mnemonic: BiTE cross-linking bypasses MHC-I immune escape.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"The molecular architecture of the mammalian circadian clock is driven by cell-autonomous, transcription-translation feedback loops (TTFL). In the positive arm of the loop, the heterodimeric transcription factors CLOCK and BMAL1 bind to canonical E-box elements within promoters, activating the transcription of the Period (PER1, PER2) and Cryptochrome (CRY1, CRY2) genes. As PER and CRY proteins accumulate in the cytoplasm, they form complexes with casein kinase 1 (CK1), undergo progressive phosphorylation, and translocate back into the nucleus during the subjective night. Once inside the nucleus, PER-CRY complexes physically interact with CLOCK-BMAL1, repressing their own transcription. Degradation of PER and CRY via the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway relieves this transcriptional repression, restarting the approximately 24-hour cycle."

What molecular mechanism is responsible for closing the negative feedback arm of the circadian clock loop?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"The molecular architecture of the mammalian circadian clock is driven by cell-autonomous, transcription-translation feedback loops (TTFL). In the positive arm of the loop, the heterodimeric transcription factors CLOCK and BMAL1 bind to canonical E-box elements within promoters, activating the transcription of the Period (PER1, PER2) and Cryptochrome (CRY1, CRY2) genes. As PER and CRY proteins accumulate in the cytoplasm, they form complexes with casein kinase 1 (CK1), undergo progressive phosphorylation, and translocate back into the nucleus during the subjective night. Once inside the nucleus, PER-CRY complexes physically interact with CLOCK-BMAL1, repressing their own transcription. Degradation of PER and CRY via the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway relieves this transcriptional repression, restarting the approximately 24-hour cycle."

What molecular mechanism is responsible for closing the negative feedback arm of the circadian clock loop?
opts: Immediate enzymatic breakdown of all cellular chromatin by casein kinase 1.
Permanent phosphorylation of cell membranes preventing messenger RNA translation.
Nuclear translocation of PER-CRY complexes that physically repress CLOCK-BMAL1 transcriptional activity.
Continuous secretion of melatonin directly into cytoplasmic ribosome clusters.
options: Immediate enzymatic breakdown of all cellular chromatin by casein kinase 1.
Permanent phosphorylation of cell membranes preventing messenger RNA translation.
Nuclear translocation of PER-CRY complexes that physically repress CLOCK-BMAL1 transcriptional activity.
Continuous secretion of melatonin directly into cytoplasmic ribosome clusters.
explanation:
Tahlil: Sirkad ritmining manfiy qayta aloqa qismi PER-CRY oqsillari yadroga qaytib kirib, o'zlarini faollashtirgan CLOCK-BMAL1 transkripsiyasini to'xtatishi (repressing their own transcription) bilan yakunlanadi.
To'g'ri javob: PER-CRY komplekslarining yadroga kirib, CLOCK-BMAL1 transkripsiyasini fizik jihatdan bostirishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: xromatinni parchalash emas; membranani fosforillash emas; melatonin ajratish emas.
Eslatma: TTFL loop: CLOCK-BMAL1 faollashtiradi -> PER-CRY yadroga qaytib ularni bostiradi.
mnemonic: Circadian negative feedback = PER-CRY translocates to nucleus and inhibits CLOCK-BMAL1.

The magnetic moment of a lepton deviates slightly from Dirac's tree-level prediction of g = 2 due to radiative quantum loop corrections—virtual particle-antiparticle pairs flickering in and out of the vacuum. If the observed experimental value continues to exceed Standard Model quantum electrodynamic, electroweak, and hadronic vacuum polarization calculations with 5-sigma statistical significance, it serves as definitive evidence that unobserved supersymmetric particles or novel dark gauge bosons are participating in the virtual quantum vacuum loops."

Why does a confirmed discrepancy in the muon g-2 measurement imply the existence of new physics?

Nondetachability: implicatures remain attached even when lexical synonyms are substituted.
Cancellability / Defeasibility: conversational implicatures can be explicitly revoked or canceled without creating a logical contradiction.
Invariance: implicatures are mathematically immutable across all possible universes.
explanation: Conversational implicatures are defeasible (cancellable): a speaker can explicitly cancel the scalar implicature ('some, but not all') by adding 'in fact, all of them did' without semantic contradiction. (Entailments, by contrast, cannot be canceled).
mnemonic: Defeasibility: Implicatures can be canceled ('some, in fact all') without contradiction.

q:
Read the academic passage:
"Hydrogen energy systems face a substantial technical barrier in terrestrial storage and transport, governed by hydrogen's extremely low volumetric energy density at ambient temperature and pressure. Compressed gas storage requires composite carbon-fiber cylinders operating at 700 bar, imposing severe energy compression penalties and mechanical rupture concerns. Cryogenic liquefaction achieves superior density (71 g/L) but requires cooling hydrogen to -253 degrees Celsius, consuming up to thirty percent of the fuel's lower heating value solely for refrigeration, alongside continuous losses from cryogenic boil-off. Consequently, solid-state storage via reversible metal hydrides or chemical hydrogen carriers like liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHCs) is gaining traction, although high thermodynamic desorption temperatures and dehydrogenation kinetics remain limiting factors."

What is the primary thermodynamic penalty associated with cryogenic liquid hydrogen storage?
question:
Read the academic passage:
"Hydrogen energy systems face a substantial technical barrier in terrestrial storage and transport, governed by hydrogen's extremely low volumetric energy density at ambient temperature and pressure. Compressed gas storage requires composite carbon-fiber cylinders operating at 700 bar, imposing severe energy compression penalties and mechanical rupture concerns. Cryogenic liquefaction achieves superior density (71 g/L) but requires cooling hydrogen to -253 degrees Celsius, consuming up to thirty percent of the fuel's lower heating value solely for refrigeration, alongside continuous losses from cryogenic boil-off. Consequently, solid-state storage via reversible metal hydrides or chemical hydrogen carriers like liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHCs) is gaining traction, although high thermodynamic desorption temperatures and dehydrogenation kinetics remain limiting factors."

What is the primary thermodynamic penalty associated with cryogenic liquid hydrogen storage?
opts: A large fraction of the stored energy is consumed by the intensive refrigeration required to reach liquefaction.
Liquid hydrogen spontaneously ignites when kept below minus two hundred degrees Celsius.
The complete conversion of liquid hydrogen into non-reactive carbon dioxide gas.
Liquid hydrogen exhibits zero density, causing it to escape through all metallic tanks.
options: A large fraction of the stored energy is consumed by the intensive refrigeration required to reach liquefaction.
Liquid hydrogen spontaneously ignites when kept below minus two hundred degrees Celsius.
The complete conversion of liquid hydrogen into non-reactive carbon dioxide gas.
Liquid hydrogen exhibits zero density, causing it to escape through all metallic tanks.
explanation:
Tahlil: Suyuq vodorodni saqlashning eng katta termodinamik zarari shundaki, uni -253 darajagacha sovutish uchun vodorod tarkibidagi umumiy energiyaning 30% gacha bo'lgan qismi faqat sovutishga sarflanadi (consumes up to 30% of heating value).
To'g'ri javob: Saqlangan energiyaning katta qismi suyuqlanish haroratiga erishish uchun zarur sovutishga sarflanishi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: -200 darajada o'z-o'zidan yonmaydi; karbonat angidridga aylanmaydi; zichligi nol emas.
Eslatma: Cryogenic liquefaction penalty = 30% energiya sovutishga ketadi.
mnemonic: Cryogenic hydrogen penalty = Heavy energy consumption during deep cooling.

q: If you substitute synonymous expressions into an utterance (e.g. changing *"He was slightly inebriated"* to *"He was somewhat intoxicated"* or *"He had consumed alcohol"*), the conversational implicature that he was not sober persists. This property is known in pragmatics as:
opts: Reinforceability: repeating a word until it loses all semiotic meaning.
Defeasibility: the capacity of an implicature to be refuted by laboratory data.
Calculability: the mathematical algorithm used to compute acoustic decibels.
Nondetachability: the implicature is tied to the semantic content of the message, not to the specific linguistic lexical form used.
explanation: 'Nondetachability' means that you cannot detach the implicature simply by switching to a synonym with the same semantic sense; the implicature arises from the propositional meaning itself.
mnemonic: Nondetachability: Synonyms carry the exact same conversational implicature.

q: Neil Fleming'ning VARK modeliga (Visual, Auditory, Read/Write, Kinesthetic) muvofiq dars rejalashtirayotgan o'qituvchi o'quv materialini qanday taqdim etishi eng to'g'ri hisoblanadi?
opts: Sinfni to'rt xonaga ajratib, har bir o'quvchiga faqat bitta uslubda dars o'tish va boshqa uslublarni taqiqlash.

Darsda ko'rgazmali infografika (Visual), tushuntirish va audio eshitish (Auditory), matn bilan ishlash (Read/Write) hamda rolli o'yin yoki harakatli amaliyot (Kinesthetic) elementlarini uyg'unlashtirgan multimodal taqdimot yaratish.
Faqat audiokitoblarni eshitish bilan cheklanib, daftarga yozishni to'liq man qilish.
Barcha o'quvchilarga bir xil uslubda faqat qora doskadan ko'chirib yozishni majburlash.
explanation: VARK modeli o'quvchilarning barchasini qat'iy bitta tor qolipga tiqish uchun emas, balki darsda multimodal (turli idrok kanallariga qaratilgan) resurslar va faoliyatlarni uyg'unlashtirib, har bir o'quvchiga materialni qulay yo'l bilan o'zlashtirish imkonini berish uchun qo'llaniladi.
mnemonic: VARK = Ko'rish, Eshitish, O'qish/Yozish, Harakat uyg'unligi (Multimodal ta'lim).

Matnni vizual grafik organayzerlar (Venn diagrammasi, oqim sxemasi), lug'at glosariysi va jumlalarni boshlovchi tayanch qoliplar (sentence starters) bilan ta'minlash

q:
Choose the option that reflects formal academic style in the comparative clause:

*"Urban air pollution exacerbates cardiovascular disease, as _____ in numerous epidemiological cohort studies."*
opts: demonstrated has it
it has demonstrated
is being demonstrated it
has been demonstrated
explanation:
Tahlil: Ingliz tili oliy grammatikasi (C1/C2) qoidalariga ko'ra, berilgan jumla maxsus sintaktik konstruksiyani talab qiladi. Gap boshida inkor yoki cheklovchi yuklama, ergash gapli inversion, shart mayli yoki bo'lingan gap (cleft sentence) qo'llanganda, odatiy so'z tartibi o'zgaradi va yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi (subject-auxiliary inversion). (In formal academic English, comparative clauses with 'as' frequently exhibit inversion or passive ellipsis: 'as has been demonstrated in numerous studies'.)
To'g'ri javob: "has been demonstrated" varianti barcha sintaktik talablarga (yordamchi fe'l, asosiy fe'l shakli, zamon va shaxs moslashuviga) to'liq javob berib, rasmiy akademik me'yorni to'liq ta'minlaydi.
Chalg'ituvchilar: Boshqa variantlarda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'z tartibi buzilmagan (invertatsiya qilinmagan), zamon shakli noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri fe'l shakli (V1/V2/V3 chalkashligi) ishlatilgan.
Eslatma: Comparative As-Clause: 'as has been shown / as has been demonstrated'.
options: demonstrated has it
it has demonstrated
is being demonstrated it
has been demonstrated

mnemonic: Comparative As-Clause: 'as has been shown / as has been demonstrated'.

q: Zarina CLIL darsida o'quvchilar uchun til vositalarini tanlashda Do Coyle'ning 'Language Triptych' (Til triptixi) modelidan foydalanmoqda. Ushbu modelga ko'ra 'Language FOR learning' tushunchasi nimani anglatadi?
opts: O'quvchilar topshiriq bajarish davomida kutilmaganda ehtiyoj sezadigan yangi so'zlar
Fanning asosiy lug'at boyligi va atamalari (masalan: fotosintez, xlorofill)
O'quvchilarga dars jarayonida vazifalarni bajarish uchun zarur bo'ladigan funksional muloqot tili (bahslashish, savol berish, guruhda taklif kiritish, xulosa yasash)
Faqat o'qituvchining sinfni boshqarish uchun aytadigan buyruqlari
explanation: Language Triptych 3 qismdan iborat: 1) Language OF learning (mavzuviy atamalar); 2) Language FOR learning (darsda ishlash, bahslashish, fikr bildirish uchun zarur funksional til); 3) Language THROUGH learning (o'rganish jarayonida kashf qilinadigan yangi til birliklari).
mnemonic: Language Triptych: OF (Atamalar), FOR (Faoliyat tili), THROUGH (Yangi kashf qilingan til).

q: Sherzod kimyo fani bilan integratsiyalashgan CLIL darsida 8-sinf o'quvchilariga murakkab ilmiy matn berdi. O'quvchilar matn mazmunini tushunishda qiynalmasliklari uchun Sherzod qaysi 'scaffolding' (pedagogik tayanch) strategiyasini qo'llashi eng maqsadga muvofiq?
opts: O'quvchilarga lug'atdan foydalanishni qat'iyan taqiqlab, matnni yodlatish
Matnni olib qo'yib, o'quvchilarga mavzuni faqat o'zbek tilida konspekt qildirish
Matndagi barcha gaplarni o'qituvchi o'zi so'zma-so'z tarjima qilib berishi
Matnni vizual grafik organayzerlar (Venn diagrammasi, oqim sxemasi), lug'at glosariysi va jumlalarni boshlovchi tayanch qoliplar (sentence starters) bilan ta'minlash
explanation: CLIL darslarida fan mazmuni murakkab bo'lgani sababli kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirish uchun vizual organayzerlar, jadvallar, glosariy va sintaktik qoliplar (sentence frames) eng samarali scaffolding hisoblanadi.
mnemonic: CLIL Scaffolding = Grafik organayzer + Glosariy + Sintaktik qoliplar.
